title: Senior Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a Senior Business Development Representative (BDR) who is highly motivated, results-driven, and experienced in B2B prospecting and outbound sales to help accelerate our growth.



In this role, you will take ownership of building our sales pipeline by identifying high-quality prospects, executing strategic outreach campaigns, and creating opportunities for our sales team. You will be responsible for researching target markets, engaging decision-makers, qualifying leads, and generating consistent sales opportunities through effective prospecting strategies.



This is an ideal opportunity for someone who has strong outbound sales experience, understands the B2B sales process, and can independently manage lead generation activities while continuously improving outreach performance.



Key Responsibilities

- Research and identify high-value prospects within target industries and markets.

- Develop and execute outbound prospecting strategies through email, LinkedIn, phone calls, and other channels.

- Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other sales intelligence tools.

- Engage with key decision-makers and identify business opportunities.

- Qualify leads based on business needs, budget, authority, timeline, and fit.

- Schedule qualified meetings and sales opportunities for the sales team.

- Manage and maintain accurate prospect information and activity records in the CRM.

- Track outreach performance, analyze results, and recommend improvements to increase conversion rates.

- Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to optimize lead generation campaigns.

title: Property Accountant (RCG Portfolio)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Property Accountant to join our team supporting the RCG Portfolio. In this role, you will oversee multi-entity property accounting, maintain accurate financial records, and manage tenant billing operations across commercial and multi-family real estate assets.



Working directly with AV Leads and Property Managers, you will ensure total ledger accuracy, execute timely bank reconciliations, manage lease financials, and deliver thorough month-end reporting packages tailored to RCG’s operational standards.



Key Responsibilities:



Property Accounting & Bookkeeping: 

Maintain accurate general ledgers across assigned properties and corporate entities. Execute daily cash management, monitor account balances, perform multi-account bank reconciliations, process AP/AR transactions, and drive month-end and year-end close routines (journal entries, accruals, prepaid schedules).



Tenant Management & Revenue Recovery: 

Oversee complex tenant recovery operations, including calculating and billing Common Area Maintenance (CAM), real estate tax reimbursements, and insurance/utility pass-throughs. Track security deposits, manage lease renewals, monitor delinquencies, and lead collection efforts.



Lease Financial Management & Abstracting: 

Review new and modified lease agreements to verify accounting system schedules against contractual terms. Maintain a centralized lease abstract database tracking key renewal dates, percentage rent clauses, CAM caps, and audit rights.



Portfolio Reporting & PM Support: 

Partner with Property and Asset Managers to deliver monthly financial reporting packages (Balance Sheets, Income Statements, Budget-vs.-Actual variance analyses), as well as compliance reports for lenders and investors.



Qualifications & Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Professional Experience: 3+ years in property accounting, real estate bookkeeping, or multi-entity financial management across commercial, retail, or multi-family real estate assets.



Software Proficiency: 

Hands-on experience with real estate accounting software (e.g., AppFolio, Yardi Voyager, MRI Software, or QuickBooks Online).



CAM & Tax Reconciliations: 

Proven expertise executing annual CAM, property tax, and insurance reconciliations for commercial tenants.

Advanced Excel & Analytical Skills: Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, financial modeling).



Communication & Remote Work Style: 

Exceptional written and spoken English, meticulous attention to detail, and a self-motivated ability to independently manage multi-property deadlines during monthly close cycles.

title: MLS Data Entry Specialist – MLS EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

title: Credit Repair Specialist/ Customer Service
description:
Credit Repair Virtual Assistant / Credit Restoration Specialist



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote

Industry: Credit Repair / Financial Services



We are looking for an experienced Credit Repair Virtual Assistant who understands credit reports, dispute processes, and client communication.



We are looking for someone who can work quickly, pay close attention to detail, communicate professionally, and get results. This is not an entry-level position. We want someone who already understands credit repair and can learn our systems and processes quickly.



Your Responsibilities



* Review client credit reports and identify inaccurate, outdated, incomplete, or potentially unverifiable information.

* Work on negative items including late payments, collections, charge-offs, and other derogatory accounts.

* Prepare and manage credit disputes and supporting documentation.

* File and manage CFPB complaints and FTC reports when appropriate.

* Communicate with creditors, collection agencies, credit bureaus, and customer-service departments.

* Make phone calls when necessary to research and resolve client issues.

* Track client disputes, responses, deadlines, and progress.

* Provide professional and timely updates to clients.

* Maintain detailed and organized client files.

* Work inside Credit Repair Cloud (CRC).

* Follow company procedures and maintain strict client confidentiality.

* Learn new dispute strategies, software, and company procedures as needed.



Requirements



* Previous hands-on experience in credit repair or credit restoration.

* Strong understanding of credit reports and negative tradelines.

* Experience working with late payments and collections.

* Experience with Credit Repair Cloud is strongly preferred.

* Experience filing CFPB complaints and FTC reports.

* Strong English communication skills — both written and verbal.

* Comfortable speaking with creditors, bureaus, and customer-service representatives.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Able to work independently and meet deadlines.

* Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.

* Professional attitude and strong work ethic.

* Must be willing to learn and follow our processes.



The Person We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who doesn’t need to be micromanaged.



You should be able to look at a client’s credit report, understand what you are looking at, determine what needs to be addressed, properly document your work, and communicate professionally with the client and our team.



Speed matters, but accuracy matters more.



We want someone who takes ownership of their work, asks questions when necessary, and continuously looks for ways to improve.



Important



Please do not apply if you have no experience with credit repair.



When applying, tell us:



1. How many years of credit repair experience you have.

2. Your experience with Credit Repair Cloud.

3. Your experience getting late payments removed.

4. Your experience getting collections removed.

5. Your experience with CFPB complaints.

6. Your experience with FTC reports.

7. Your experience speaking with creditors, bureaus, or collection agencies.

8. Your desired monthly salary.

9. Your available working hours.



We will prioritize applicants who can demonstrate real hands-on experience and actual knowledge of the credit repair process.



Compensation



Competitive pay based on experience and skill level and bonus based on performance.



Opportunity for long-term employment and additional responsibilities as the company grows.



Video Introduction is Required

title: Creative Brand, Social Media & Design Assistant for Great Stone Dragon
description:
Pay: $60 USD per week, flat weekly rate

Schedule: Flexible, ongoing position

Time Zone: Must have strong availability during Pacific Time (PST/PDT)

Required Platforms: Canva, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Express



About the Role



Great Stone Dragon is a collectible fantasy pin business, and I am looking for a long-term Creative Brand, Social Media & Design Assistant to join my team.



I already have an assistant who works with me on an ongoing basis, and I am looking to add another creative person because the workload of the business has increased. I also want someone who can bring fresh ideas, creativity, and a new perspective to help continue building Great Stone Dragon into a stronger and more recognizable brand.



This role is not limited to completing individual graphics. I am looking for someone who can become familiar with the business, understand my design preferences, contribute ideas, support social media, and help expand the overall brand identity across different areas of the business.



The workload may vary from week to week depending on launches, events, presales, product announcements, social media needs, and other business activities.



Because of this, I am looking for someone who is comfortable with a flexible ongoing weekly arrangement rather than someone who requires a strict project by project structure.



Compensation



This position pays a flat rate of $60 USD per week.



The workload may vary depending on what is happening within the business.



Some weeks may be lighter, while launch weeks, events, or busy sales periods may require additional creative support.



I am specifically looking for someone who is comfortable with this type of flexible weekly arrangement.



Design Software Experience Required



Strong experience with the following platforms is important for this role:



Canva



Canva will be one of the primary platforms used for recurring business and social media materials.



You should be comfortable with:



• Creating polished and professional Canva designs

• Working within existing Canva templates

• Creating reusable templates

• Organizing design files properly

• Resizing designs for different platforms

• Updating product images, dates, prices, and launch information

• Using brand fonts, colors, graphics, and logos consistently

• Creating social posts, stories, flyers, and promotional graphics

• Building templates that can easily be reused later



Adobe Illustrator



You should also have experience using Adobe Illustrator, especially for more advanced design needs.



This may include:



• Vector graphics

• Packaging layouts

• Print ready artwork

• Product collateral

• Custom graphic elements

• Adjusting or creating brand assets

• Preparing artwork for professional printing

• Working with existing vector files



Adobe Express



Experience with Adobe Express is also preferred for fast turnaround creative assets, resizing, social graphics, and other marketing content.



You should be comfortable moving between Canva, Illustrator, and Adobe Express depending on what the project requires.



Social Media Experience



I am also looking for someone who is comfortable with social media and content creation, especially Instagram.



This role will involve helping develop a more cohesive and recognizable social media presence for Great Stone Dragon.



You should understand:



• Instagram feed design

• Instagram Stories

• Reel covers

• Product launch content

• Promotional graphics

• Giveaway posts

• Engagement focused content

• Brand consistency across social posts

• How to create visually appealing content for a product based business

• How different posts work together as part of an overall feed



A major goal is to move away from every post looking unrelated and instead create a recognizable system where someone can tell that a post belongs to Great Stone Dragon before even seeing the username.



I would also love someone who can suggest new content ideas, layouts, social media concepts, and ways to improve brand awareness.



Helping Build the Brand



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



I am not only looking for someone who can make graphics when I tell them exactly what to create.



I want someone who can help me continue developing and building out the Great Stone Dragon brand.



You should be comfortable looking at an existing brand guide and finding new ways to expand it while keeping the identity consistent.



This may include helping develop:



• New social media concepts

• Recurring content series

• Brand templates

• Packaging ideas

• Customer experience materials

• Event branding

• Promotional materials

• Website graphics

•
 graphics

• Print materials

• Product presentation ideas

• Ways to make the brand more recognizable

• New creative applications of existing brand elements



I want someone who thinks beyond the individual assignment and considers how each design contributes to the overall brand.



Current Brand Direction



Great Stone Dragon already has an established professional brand identity.



I am not looking for a complete rebrand or a new logo.



Instead, you will be helping expand and refine the existing identity.



The current direction is:



• Sophisticated

• Simplified

• Elevated

• Premium

• Collectible

• Whimsical

• Polished

• Recognizable



The brand primarily uses burgundy, gold, ivory, and navy along with established dragon imagery, clouds, decorative details, patterns, and other elements included in the existing brand guide.



A significant portion of my current social media still reflects my older branding, so I am now transitioning toward a much stronger and more consistent use of the new brand identity.



Types of Projects



Projects may include:



Social Media



• Instagram posts

• Product launch graphics

• Presale announcements

• In hand sale graphics

• Restock announcements

• Coming soon posts

• Production updates

• Collection spotlights

• Instagram Stories

• Reel covers

• Giveaways

• Event announcements

• Informational graphics

• Promotional content

• Website announcements



Packaging & Print



• Pin backing cards

• Thank you cards

• Business cards

• Order inserts

• Pin care cards

• Collector cards

• Sticker designs

• Packaging concepts

• Mailer designs

• Tissue paper

• Packaging seals

• Box inserts

• Event signage

• Vendor materials

• QR code signs

• Promotional cards



Digital Branding



• Website banners

• Homepage graphics

•
 marketing graphics

•
 headers

• 
 graphics

• Digital advertisements

• Product graphics

• Collection graphics

• Additional marketing materials



Not every week will involve every type of project. Tasks will depend on what the business currently needs.



Creative Independence



I am looking for someone who can work independently and does not require constant micromanagement.



I will provide direction, product information, brand materials, examples, and feedback, especially while you are learning my preferences.



However, I do not want to explain every design decision step by step.



For example, if I send you a product image and tell you that I need a launch graphic, I would like you to be able to:



• Review the brand guide

• Look at previous launches

• Understand the product

• Develop a creative concept

• Create a polished design

• Present ideas without requiring constant direction



Over time, I expect you to learn what I like, what I do not like, and what feels right for Great Stone Dragon.



The goal is for you to need less direction as you become more familiar with the brand.



Work Style



The ideal person is:



• Creative

• Proactive

• Independent

• Reliable

• Organized

• Detail oriented

• Responsive

• Comfortable receiving feedback

• Able to manage tasks without constant follow up

• Able to bring new ideas to the business

• Comfortable working with changing priorities

• Interested in learning the brand deeply



I want someone who can become a creative extension of the business rather than someone who only waits for detailed instructions.



Communication & Availability



You do not need to sit at your computer all day waiting for messages.



However, I do need someone who has good availability during Pacific Time (PST/PDT) and who can generally respond within approximately 30 minutes to one hour during their normal availability.



There may occasionally be:



• Last minute product updates

• Launch changes

• Event announcements

• Social media updates

• Flyer changes

• Website graphics

• Other time sensitive requests



Because of this, I am looking for someone who checks messages regularly and is reasonably available when needed.



Communication is primarily through WhatsApp, and read receipts should remain enabled so I can easily see when important messages have been received.



Flexible Weekly Workload



There is no identical workload every week.



The needs of a small product based business naturally fluctuate.



Some weeks may be quieter, while product launches, sales, or events may require additional work.



Because of this, I am looking for someone who is comfortable with a flexible workload under the $60 flat weekly arrangement rather than someone who requires an exact number of hours or a strict project scope for every assignment.



If you prefer highly structured working hours or only project based freelance work, this position may not be the right fit.



Materials Provided



You will receive access to:



• Great Stone Dragon brand guide

• Logos

• Brand fonts

• Brand colors

• Patterns and graphic elements

• Existing Canva templates

• Previous social media posts

• Existing packaging examples

• Product photography

• Launch materials

• Business collateral

• Examples of designs I like

• Examples of designs I do not like



You will not be starting from scratch.



Ideal Experience



I am looking for someone with experience in:



• Canva

• Adobe Illustrator

• Adobe Express

• Graphic design

• Social media design

• Instagram content

• Branding

• Brand development

• Ecommerce

• Product based businesses

• Packaging design

• Print collateral

• Editable templates

• Marketing graphics



Experience with collectibles, enamel pins, fandom brands, stationery, boutique ecommerce, luxury packaging, or similar businesses is a major plus.



What Success Looks Like



I want someone who eventually understands Great Stone Dragon well enough that I can send a general request and trust that you understand the direction.



You should be able to help me continue growing Great Stone Dragon into a recognizable collectible brand where everything feels connected, including:



• Social media

• Product launches

• Packaging

• Website graphics

• Events

• Customer orders

• Promotional materials



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, contribute ideas, help strengthen the brand, and become a dependable long term member of the team.

title: Executive Integrator & Closer (US Hours) | $4–$5/hr + $100/mo Bonuses + 13th Month
description:
Job Title: Executive Integrator, Lead Generator & Sales Closer (Assistant to the Owners)



Type:** 30–35 Hours/Week (Set shift blocks with mandatory Saturdays during campaigns)

Location:** Remote (Philippines preferred)



## About Us



We operate a fast-paced, highly dynamic portfolio of businesses based in the US. Our operations span multiple distinct industries, including Luxury Event/Wedding Venues, Alternative Wellness & Energy Therapy, Real Estate Acquisitions, Property Management, and Roofing/Construction. We also run a high-ticket B2B SaaS growth agency. We are visionaries who move incredibly fast. We need a brilliant, highly organized "Right-Hand" Executive Assistant, Integrator, and Growth Specialist to manage our operational threads, assist the owners directly, and actively close new business.



## The Opportunity & The Standard



We are looking for a proactive leader who anticipates our needs before we even ask, combined with the hungry mindset of a sales closer. As the direct Executive Assistant to the owners, you will support our entire portfolio. One hour, you might be calling a roofing client to confirm a schedule; the next hour, you will be running a live Zoom demo to close a $600/month CRM package, followed by executing a social media campaign or SEO strategy.



Your Responsibilities (Growth & Operations)



The Sales & Lead Generation Engine:**

Cold Calling & Appointment Setting:** Aggressively prospect for new B2B clients by cold calling future prospects to generate new leads, as well as cold calling our existing client base for follow-ups, referrals, and cross-selling. You must be completely comfortable picking up the phone to dial.

* **Running Demos & Closing:** Conduct live Zoom presentations (using our pre-built decks and system demos) to walk prospective clients through our Turnkey SaaS packages, handle objections, and close the accounts live on the call.

* **Voice-to-Action Outbound Calling:** Take raw audio notes or quick texts from the owners and execute them immediately. You must be comfortable calling American leads, wedding couples, vendors, or corporate clients to follow up on agreements.



**The Operational Hub & Executive Assistance:**



* **Dynamic Executive Support (Social Media, SEO & Beyond):** Because you are the direct assistant to the owners, you will be asked to wear many hats. Your duties will regularly expand to include social media posting, basic SEO tasks, data entry, and ad-hoc research.

* **Continuous Training & Learning:** As our businesses evolve, so will your role. You will frequently be required to participate in training and learn completely new software systems, marketing strategies, or operational protocols.

* **Multi-Business Portfolio Support:** Act as the central operational assistant across all our brands. You must be agile enough to pivot seamlessly between sales calls, creative retreat coordination, and structured construction logistics.

* **GoHighLevel (GHL) Operational Management:** Actively work inside the platform to manage customer profiles, update pipeline opportunities, apply tags, track calendar bookings, and ensure clients are moving through the correct communication sequences.

* **GHL Specialist Collaboration:** Work hand-in-hand with our internal tech team to communicate needed system updates and help configure new GHL sub-accounts for the deals you close.

* **Property Management Support:** Update and manage guest profiles, booking adjustments, and automated rules within our property management platform (Hospitable).

* **Inbox & Workflow Triage:** Organize incoming
s and ensure tasks are executed so nothing falls through the cracks.



## Schedule & Hours



30 to 35 Hours Per Week.**

Consistent Shift Blocks (US Central Time):** You will work set shift blocks (typically 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM CDT, or 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM CDT). Your schedule will stay constant for 2-week blocks so you have stability and predictability, rather than fluctuating daily.



Mandatory Saturdays:** Saturday availability is strictly mandatory during our active campaigning periods and to handle urgent client/guest needs for our event venues over the weekend.



Mandatory Daily Meetings:** You will attend a daily video team meeting during your shift to align on the day's priorities.



Compensation, Long-Term Stability & Role Scope



This role heavily rewards reliability, clear communication, and the ability to close deals.



**Important Note on Role Scope:** Because this is an all-encompassing Executive Assistant role, extreme adaptability is a fundamental requirement. You will constantly be asked to handle new types of tasks (such as SEO or social media) and learn new skills. Your hourly rate and bonus structure comprehensively cover this versatility. Therefore, requests for additional baseline compensation to execute new types of tasks or undergo training will not be permitted.



**The Base Pay Scale:**



 First 60 Days (Strict Probation): $4.00 / Hour

 After 90 Days (If Retained): $5.00 / Hour



Sales Commission & Spiffs:**



2% Conversion Commission: Earn a 2% commission on every paid and closed deal that you nurtured and converted. You get rewarded whether you close the deal directly yourself, or tee it up perfectly for the team to close.

$20 Flat Spiff:** Alternatively, depending on the specific campaign structure, you will earn a flat $20 spiff for every 5 lead you successfully nurture and convert into a closed deal with in month max $100.



Monthly Performance Bonuses (Up to $100 maximum bonus per month):



Rapid Response Bonus ($25/month):** For consistently responding to calls and messages within 15 minutes during shift hours.



Accuracy & Implementation Bonus ($25/month):** For taking precise meeting notes and perfectly implementing action items.



Zero-Leakage Pipeline Hygiene Bonus ($25/month):** For keeping the GoHighLevel pipelines perfectly updated, ensuring no lead or task is left untagged at the end of your shift.



Perfect Reliability Bonus ($25/month):** For having zero unexcused absences and being perfectly on time for every single daily video meeting and weekend shift.



The Loyalty Benefits:**



Health Insurance Stipend:** After 6 months of employment, you will receive a $30/month stipend provided specifically to cover your local health insurance (HMO) costs.



13th-Month Pay:** We offer a pro-rated 13th-month bonus in December for team members who stay with us long-term.



Who You Are



The Closer Mindset:** You are not afraid to ask for the sale. You have a highly professional, confident, and neutral English-speaking accent. You are completely comfortable running live video presentations for American business owners.

* **Extreme Adaptability:** You thrive in an environment where tasks vary daily. You can switch gears from closing a software deal, to posting on social media, to tracking a roofing permit without missing a beat.

* **Software Familiarity:** You have hands-on experience navigating GoHighLevel (GHL) and are comfortable running software demos. Experience with property management tools (like Hospitable) is a massive plus.

* **Technical Reliability:** You must have a primary wired fiber internet connection AND a backup mobile hotspot or secondary ISP to ensure Zoom calls never drop.



 How to Apply



If you are ready to be our right-hand partner, drive sales, and manage our portfolio, please apply with the following:



1. A brief summary of your sales/closing experience, lead generation skills, and administrative background.

2. A link to a 1-minute video recording (using Loom) introducing yourself and giving us a 15-second "mock pitch" of a product you love, so we can see your camera presence and hear your spoken English.

3. Put the phrase "Growth Integrator & Closer" in the subject line of your application so we know you read these instructions completely.

Pauline Interiors is a boutique residential interior design studio based in Palm Beach, Florida. We work on high-end residential projects and have a large library of professionally photographed interiors, project imagery, installation photos, samples, details, and behind-the-scenes content and videos.

I am looking for someone with a strong visual eye to help turn this existing library into polished Instagram content.

This is not primarily a social media strategy, community management, or engagement role.

The biggest need is visual curation.

I want someone who can look through a large folder of images and videos and independently identify:

- what should lead a carousel

- what should become a Reel

- what image should be the Reel cover

- how images should be sequenced so the content feels cohesive and editorial

I do not want to have to pre-select all the photographs for you.

Pauline Interiors has an established visual direction and brand. The goal is to help execute that direction consistently while taking the content-selection process off my plate.

The ideal person has experience creating content for interior design, architecture, luxury hospitality, fashion, lifestyle, editorial, or another visually sophisticated brand.

You should have strong taste and restraint. Pauline Interiors is a luxury residential design studio, so the content should feel elevated, timeless and editorial — not overly trendy, graphic-heavy, or like a generic social media template.

Responsibilities may include:

- Reviewing large photography folders and curating the strongest images

- Creating Instagram carousels

- Editing simple, polished Reels using still photography and/or video

- Selecting Reel covers

- Sequencing imagery thoughtfully

- Suggesting music when appropriate

- Organizing content into a monthly posting plan

- Drafting captions using an established brand voice

- Preparing finished posts for approval

- Eventually assisting with scheduling approved content

Tools may include Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Drive and Instagram.

Important: Visual judgment is much more important to me than years of social media experience.

5. Your hourly rate.

6. Your current availability.

Please do not create any unpaid sample content for Pauline Interiors as part of the initial application. A small group of finalists will be invited to complete a paid visual curation exercise.

We’re looking for someone creative, hardworking, resourceful, detail-oriented, and willing to learn. You don't need to know everything on day one. We can train the right person, but you must already be comfortable creating images and editing videos.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

title: High-Performance Executive Assistant (U.S. Tax & Executive Operations)
description:

This role is ideal for someone with a background in U.S. tax, accounting, bookkeeping, financial reporting, or business analysis who wants to move beyond traditional administrative work and become a strategic partner to executive leadership.



If you thrive in fast-paced environments, think analytically, and take ownership without waiting to be told what to do, keep reading.



Who We Are



DAP Brands is a community of high performers building businesses that create real impact.



Our leadership team moves quickly, thinks strategically, and expects people to solve problems—not simply complete tasks.



We value:



-Speed

-Accountability

-Precision

-Emotional maturity

-Ownership

-Loyalty to the mission (not ego)



What This Role Really Is



This role combines Executive Support, Financial Operations, Data Analysis, and Business Execution.



Your primary responsibility is to help leadership make better decisions by organizing financial and operational information into clear, actionable insights.



You'll support executive initiatives while ensuring critical business, accounting, and tax-related information is accurate, organized, and decision-ready.



You'll help:



-Organize and analyze financial, operational, and business data

-Review accounting, bookkeeping, and U.S. tax-related reports for accuracy and completeness

-Assist leadership in monitoring financial performance and operational metrics

-Financial Analysis

-Business Analytics

-Audit or Compliance

-Needs constant reassurance or supervision

-Prefers slow-moving corporate environments

-Have experience in accounting, bookkeeping, finance, U.S. tax, or business analysis

-Are highly organized and analytical

-Spots financial or operational issues before others do

-Takes initiative without waiting to be asked

This role offers:



-Competitive compensation based on experience and performance

-Direct exposure to executive leadership and strategic decision-making

title: Email Marketing & GoHighLevel Automation Specialist
GoHighLevel Automation Specialist / Senior GHL Operator
description:
GoHighLevel Automation Specialist / Senior GHL Operator

Remote | Part-Time / Project-Based Initially | Opportunity to Grow to Full time.



Revenue Doctor is looking for a highly experienced GoHighLevel specialist who can step into an existing production environment and be productive from day one.



This is not an entry-level position, and this is not a role where we will teach you GoHighLevel. You should already be extremely comfortable working inside GHL, diagnosing problems, building advanced automations, improving existing systems, and testing your own work without extensive supervision.



Our immediate work involves a home-services client using GoHighLevel as a core operating system for lead capture, customer communication, sales follow-up, scheduling, reviews, reactivation, AI, and marketing automation.



The ideal candidate should be able to open an unfamiliar GHL account, understand how it is structured, identify problems or unfinished work, and begin improving it immediately.



Responsibilities include:



* Build, modify, troubleshoot, and optimize advanced GoHighLevel workflows and automations

* Work confidently with triggers, conditions, branches, wait steps, goals, opportunities, pipelines, tags, custom fields, custom values, and workflow logic

* Build and manage lead intake, routing, missed-call text back, nurturing, appointment reminders, estimate follow-up, reactivation, referral, and review-request workflows

* Configure and troubleshoot calendars, forms, surveys, funnels, websites, landing pages, domains, DNS,
, SMS, and phone systems

* Work with LeadConnector/Twilio, A2P registration, messaging compliance, deliverability, and troubleshooting

* Understand webhooks, APIs, Zapier/Make-type integrations, and connections between GHL and external systems

* Configure and maintain Conversation AI, chat automation, and AI voice systems

* Work with snapshots and safely duplicate, migrate, and modify configurations between accounts

* Diagnose broken workflows, duplicate messaging, incorrect triggers, failed actions, pipeline issues, and integration failures

* Perform end-to-end testing before anything is deployed

* Maintain clear documentation of workflows, integrations, configurations, and changes

* Provide a brief daily update showing what was completed, tested, what remains outstanding, and any blockers

* Work collaboratively with other team members while helping document and transfer knowledge

* Proactively identify improvements instead of waiting for detailed step-by-step instructions



We are specifically looking for someone who has already managed real production GoHighLevel accounts. Agency experience is strongly preferred. Experience with home services, local service businesses, lead generation, or appointment-driven businesses is a major plus.



You should be able to demonstrate actual GHL systems you have personally built and clearly explain the logic behind them. Simply having used GHL, watched training videos, or completed a course is not enough.



Working hours are somewhat flexible, but you must be responsive during agreed working periods and have some availability overlapping U.S. Central Time. Working time and deliverables will be tracked. We care more about measurable output and quality than simply being online.



The role will initially be part
-based. Compensation will generally be approximately $1,000–$1,500 USD per month depending on hours, experience, capability, and performance, with the opportunity for additional hours and advancement as Revenue Doctor grows.



Qualified candidates will complete a short paid practical GHL assessment before being hired. You may be given an existing workflow or automation and asked to analyze it, identify issues, improve it, test it, and explain your work.



When applying, please include your years of GoHighLevel experience, examples of systems you have personally built, experience with workflows, automations, Twilio/LeadConnector, APIs, AI tools, your availability, expected compensation, and a short explanation of the most complex GHL automation you have personally built.

title: Bookkeeper & Payroll VA| NDIS experience
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with strong, hands-on Xero payroll experience and proven award interpretation (SCHADS Award experience highly regarded) will be prioritised for this role.



A registered NDIS provider operating across multiple entities needs a full-time Bookkeeper & Payroll Specialist to own high-volume daily bookkeeping and fortnightly payroll under the direction of the company's main accountant. The key challenge is accuracy and consistency: payroll must be error-free, bank reconciliations must be kept current across nine accounts despite receipts and remittances coming from many different people, and every rental property and utility bill must receive its correct treatment.



Success looks like payroll reaching final review error-free, bank reconciliations staying close to current, no repeated mistakes, and over time, a VA who improves the checklists and systems rather than working around them.



What You'll Own



Payroll



Process fortnightly payroll in Xero for 60 to 100 employees across multiple entities

Cross-check timesheets through the approval chain (care coordinator approval, then manager approval) before they flow into Xero

Process manual timesheets submitted by
 and through SharePoint

Apply correct pay, penalty and weekend rates under the SCHADS Award and internal rules, working through the documented payroll checklist in full every pay run

Prepare for and attend the final payslip check during payroll weeks

Manage the payroll mailbox, responding to staff, HR and manager queries about pay and timesheets



Bank Reconciliations



Reconcile all nine Xero bank accounts daily, often more than 15 transactions per account per day

For spend transactions: obtain the correct receipt, enter it as a bill with the correct GL code and GST treatment, attach the receipt, then reconcile

For money received: reconcile against the remittance advice, chasing a remittance where one hasn't been provided

Track outstanding receipts and remittances, following up until they are cleared



Accounts Payable & Receivable



Manage bills and invoicing, and follow up late payments

Enter rental invoices for the properties the business rents, applying the correct treatment for each (staff-paid, business-invoiced, or payroll-deducted)

Apply the same treatment logic to utility bills

Liaise daily with reception, who send through invoices for reconciliation



Records & Data



Maintain asset logs

Perform data entry, maintain the internal database, and manage digital files



Inbox Management



Act as the main person responsible for four to five main inboxes, up to six to seven across the entities

Make sure every
 is actioned and routed to the right inbox, following the existing process



Ad Hoc Team Support



Once finance tasks are complete, provide administrative support to HR and the care coordinators



Process Improvement



Identify gaps or better ways of working in finance processes and raise them

Update checklists as new issues are found



What We're Looking For



Experience



Minimum 2 years in bookkeeping and finance roles

Proven payroll processing experience for a workforce with variable hours, penalty rates and award interpretation

Experience with Australian companies is required

Experience with the SCHADS Award, NDIS or aged care is a strong bonus

Experience working across multiple entities



Communication Skills



Polite, patient and understanding with every department, including HR, managers, care coordinators and reception

Clear written English for the payroll and accounts mailboxes

Able to chase receipts and remittances persistently without damaging relationships



Technical Proficiency



Xero is mandatory: high proficiency in payroll, bank reconciliation, bills, sales invoices, GL coding and GST treatment

Strong spreadsheet skills in Excel

Comfortable in Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Google Workspace and Microsoft Office

CareMaster experience is a bonus and trainable



Organisational Skills



Tracks open items across nine bank accounts without losing anything, even when receipts take days to arrive

Holds and applies different treatments across two dozen properties and their utility bills

Manages six to seven inboxes and a significant weekly meeting load while keeping daily reconciliations current



Non-Negotiables



Follows documented procedures exactly, every time

Treats every error as a lesson — the same mistake shouldn't happen twice

Improves the system rather than working around it, and flags a better way of doing something

Fully focused during work hours, with zero tolerance for outside work

Calm under volume, handling daily reconciliations, fortnightly payroll and multiple inboxes without quality slipping

Discreet with payroll and staff financial data — confidentiality is essential



Working Arrangements



Full-time, under the direction of the main accountant

Completes payroll-week workload within contracted hours (no ongoing overtime expected)

Comfortable working where documentation is still being refined, without being thrown in before ready



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of a critical finance function, with zero-error payroll as a clear, respected standard

Room to shape and improve checklists and systems, not just follow them

Join a business growing from 60 towards 100 employees, with the role scaling alongside it

A team culture built on people looking after people, where attitude and integrity are valued as much as skill



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction. It helps us shortlist quickly.

title: Analytics & Tracking Specialist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and

Tegelstudio (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. Most of our

websites generate leads: the goal is a showroom appointment or a request for advice, not an online sale.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You make sure that everything that matters is measured, and that the numbers can be trusted. We are bringing

our brand websites together on one WordPress Multisite: 13 brand sites to start, growing to 25+. You design the

measurement once, so it works for every brand: which events we track, how they reach GA4, Meta and Google

Ads, and how the visitor’s consent is respected. Then you turn the data into one dashboard per brand that our

team leads steer by. About a third of your time goes to our bathroom brand, Sanitairstudio, and a small part to

our tile webshop; the rest goes to the other brand sites in the group.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Start with an audit: which analytics properties, tag containers, pixels and ad accounts exist across our

brands, who owns them, who has access, and what is measured today.

Write the measurement plan: one set of events, parameters and names for all brands (form submit, phone

and WhatsApp click, appointment request, download), and which of them count as conversions.

Specify the data layer for our design system, so our WordPress developer builds it into the templates once,

and set up Google Tag Manager so that one setup serves every brand site.

Set up GA4 per brand plus a group view, and connect the ad platforms: Meta Pixel and Conversions API with

deduplication, and Google Ads conversions.

Keep it compliant in the EU: a consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2, tags that respect the visitor’s

choice, and no personal data in analytics.

Follow leads past the form: with our automation expert, pass the source of each lead (UTM, click IDs) into

our CRM (Bitrix24), so we see which channel brings appointments and sales, not just form fills.

Build a Looker Studio dashboard per brand and one for the group, send a short monthly report, and check

every month that analytics, form entries and CRM still match. Fix double counting and whatever broke.'



REQUIRED SKILLS

2+ years of hands-on tracking work with GA4 and Google Tag Manager, on more than one website.

Google Tag Manager in depth: data layer events, triggers and variables, lookup tables, workspaces and

versions, Preview mode.

BKG · Vacature 5 van 10 · Analytics & Tracking Specialist · 2 oktober 2026 1 / 4

GA4 in depth: events and key events, custom dimensions, cross-domain measurement, internal-traffic

filters, DebugView.

Meta Pixel and Conversions API: server events, deduplication with event IDs, and reading the diagnostics in

Events Manager.

Consent for EU visitors: Google Consent Mode v2 with a consent management platform. You know what may

and may not fire before consent.

Lead-generation tracking: forms, phone and chat clicks, and UTM and click IDs passed through hidden form

fields into a CRM.

You write a measurement plan others can follow, document what you set up, and check your own work: test

submissions, and comparing analytics with form entries and the CRM.

Clear written English. You can tell non-technical colleagues what a number does and does not mean.



TOOLS WE USE

This is our stack. GA4 and Google Tag Manager are required; experience with the rest is a plus. Tell us which

ones you have worked with.

GA4, Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console.

Looker Studio, with GA4, Search Console and Google Sheets as data sources.

Meta Pixel, Conversions API and Events Manager.

Google Ads conversion tracking, and Merchant Center for our tile webshop.

WordPress Multisite with Elementor Pro and Gravity Forms.

Bitrix24 (CRM) and 
.



NICE TO HAVE

Server-side Google Tag Manager.

Offline conversions: sending CRM outcomes (qualified lead, sale) back to Meta and Google Ads.

Getting ad and CRM data into dashboards without paid connectors (Google Sheets, 
, APIs).

E-commerce tracking in GA4 (purchases, Google Shopping).

Tags for Pinterest and TikTok; Microsoft Clarity.

BigQuery or SQL.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Part-time, about 6 hours per week on average. The first weeks are setup and take more hours; after that it is

mostly checks and reporting. We plan those hours with you in advance. You meet with our Dutch colleagues

during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. When a site

or a campaign goes live, you check the tracking that same day. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is

required.



EXPECTATIONS

You would rather report a number as uncertain than present a wrong one as fact. You think at the scale of 25

sites: one plan, one naming convention, one setup. You respect privacy rules even when that costs data, and

you tell us what the gaps mean for our decisions. You handle access carefully: your own user accounts with

two-factor authentication, no shared passwords, and every change published as a named version. If you spot a

way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$120/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as more brands go live. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “DATALAYER” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these

four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Describe one tracking setup you built for a lead-generation website: which conversions you tracked (forms,

calls, chat), with which tools, and how you checked that the numbers were right.

2. We will have 25 brand sites, each on its own domain, built from the same templates on one WordPress

Multisite. How do you set up GA4 and Google Tag Manager so that we see each brand separately and the

group as a whole, without maintaining 25 separate setups?

3. A visitor in the Netherlands declines cookies on our site. What do you still measure, what not, and how do

you set that up for GA4 and Meta?

4. For the same campaign and month, Meta reports 30 leads, GA4 shows 22 and our CRM has 18. Name the

most likely causes of the difference and how you would check each one.

Also include:

One example of your work: a measurement plan, a Tag Manager container (tags, triggers, variables) or a

dashboard. Screenshots are fine, and remove client names if you need to. Only share what already exists;

please don’t build anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are

available for meetings with our Dutch team.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: Part-Time Video Editor – Performance Ads for Dutch E-commerce Brand (DTC)
description:
ABOUT US

Numsy is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand based in the Netherlands, selling baby and parenting products. The Netherlands is our main market, and we're growing into other European markets step by step. Paid social (Meta and TikTok) is a big growth driver for us. We need an editor who knows what makes an ad CONVERT, not just look nice.



THE ROLE

We're looking for a part-time video editor (about 10–20 hours per week to start) who can turn raw footage, UGC and product clips into scroll-stopping ads that sell. If you deliver results, there's a clear path to more hours and eventually a full-time role.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Edit short-form ads (9:16, 4:5, 1:1) for Meta, TikTok and Instagram

• Build strong hooks in the first 1–3 seconds, plus multiple hook variations per ad

• Edit UGC-style, testimonial, problem/solution and product demo videos

• Add captions, text overlays, music, sound effects and simple motion graphics

• Make fast variations of winning ads for creative testing

• Add Dutch captions and text overlays. We provide the scripts and translations, so you don't need to speak Dutch, but you must be precise with text you can't read yourself.

• Later on, adapt ads for other EU markets using translations we provide



MUST-HAVES

• At least 2 years of video editing experience, with proven work for e-commerce or DTC brands

• A portfolio of paid social ads (not just YouTube or wedding videos)

• An understanding of direct-response principles: hooks, pacing, CTAs, pattern interrupts

• Skill in Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong attention to detail, with no typos or mismatched captions

• Good written English

• Reliability, good communication and on-time delivery

• At least 4 hours of overlap with CET (Amsterdam time)



NICE TO HAVE

• The ability to design Meta ad statics (single-image ads and carousels) in Photoshop, Figma or Canva

• Experience with baby, parenting, family or lifestyle brands

• Experience editing ads in languages other than English

• Basic motion graphics or animation

• Knowledge of ad metrics (hook rate, CTR, ROAS)

• Experience using AI tools in your workflow



WHAT WE OFFER

• Steady, long-term work with a growing European brand

• Room to grow into more hours or a full-time role

• Creative freedom, and feedback based on real ad performance data



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip these steps won't be reviewed)

1. Start your message with the word "HOOK" so we know you read the full post.

2. Send your 3–5 best video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands (links only: Google Drive, 
 or a portfolio site).

3. If you make Meta ad statics, send 2–3 examples as well.

4. For one of your ads, tell us briefly what the goal was and how it performed, if you know.

5. Tell us whether you've edited ads in a language you don't speak, and how you make sure the captions are correct.

6. Tell us which editing and design software you use.

7. Tell us how many hours per week you're available now, and how many you could work later.

8. Tell us your timezone and usual working hours.



NEXT STEPS

If we like your application, we'll invite you to a short video call. After that, you'll do a test round with us.

The shift is 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. That's 9am–5pm in Vancouver, Canada, where we're based.

This is a permanent work from home and graveyard schedule, not a rotating one. If that doesn't work for your life, please don't apply — we'd rather you skip this than quit in two months.

Call Hero is a fast-growing SaaS company based in Canada. We build AI-powered communication tools that help healthcare clinics improve the way they manage patient calls, appointments, and front desk operations.



Our customers include physical therapy clinics, chiropractic offices, dental practices, and other healthcare providers. Our mission is simple: help clinics deliver a better patient experience while increasing bookings and reducing missed opportunities.



!! The Role



You are not cold calling. You'll work warm inbound: people who have booked a demo, started a trial, missed a scheduled call, or gone quiet.



Your job is to get on the phone with a clinic owner, understand how their practice actually runs, show them what we do, and close them. You will spend at least 4 hours a day on the phone. The rest is CRM notes, follow-up, and prep.



This is NOT a virtual assistant job. No admin, data entry, design, or social media. If you don't genuinely enjoy talking to people on the phone, this role will make you miserable and we'd both regret it.

> Run scheduled demo calls with clinic owners in Canada, the US, and Australia

> Handle objections about price, timing, and existing phone systems

> Keep your pipeline clean in our CRM — every call logged, every next step dated

> Hit a monthly closed-deal target



?? What We're Looking For

> Experience with North American customers, preferably in a BPO or similar environment

> A real headset and stable wired internet (25 Mbps+)

!! Nice to Have



> Any healthcare background — our customers are clinicians, and speaking their language helps enormously

> Experience selling software or a subscription product

> Any background where you've been trained on how you sound



** Compensation

Php80,000–Php100,000 per month guaranteed base depending on experience, plus uncapped commission on every deal you close.



On-target earnings are Php80,000–Php150,000; the top of that range is what a strong closer actually earns hitting target, not a ceiling.



You'll also receive paid training, weekly coaching on your recorded calls, and a long-term full-time seat on a small team where you'll talk to the founder directly.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY (Send all completed application requirements to: 



Applications missing any of these five items will not be opened. This is not a soft preference.

Write the name of the city we're based in, then a dash, then the minimum number of hours per day you'd spend on the phone in this role. Both are stated above.

s nobody returns, people who hang up after four rings, patients calling at seven in the evening when everyone's already gone home. Our system picks those up. It's about a two-week setup, and you'd keep your existing numbers."

title: Local SEO Specialist
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and Tegelstudio (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. Customers visit our showroom before they buy, so being found on Google Maps matters to us.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You make our physical locations easy to find and easy to choose in Google Maps and local search. The biggest one is the Sanitairstudio showroom: more than 70 complete bathrooms on 3,200 sqm. You keep our Google Business Profiles complete and active, make our business details consistent across the web, help us earn and answer reviews, and track how we rank in the towns around us. You follow the playbook of our SEO lead and you stay inside Google’s guidelines: real locations, real names, real reviews. About a third of your time goes to Sanitairstudio; the rest goes to the other locations of the BKG group.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Start with an audit: every profile and listing that exists for our addresses and brand names (Google, Apple Maps, Bing and Dutch directories), who owns it, and what is wrong, double or outdated.

Keep our Google Business Profiles complete and current: categories, services, products, opening hours (including holidays), appointment link, photos and videos.

Make name, address and phone number (NAP) consistent everywhere: fix wrong listings first, then add the directories that matter in the Netherlands.

Post weekly on each profile, with photos and news from our showroom and content team.

Reviews: help our store team ask every customer for a review in an honest way, draft a reply to every review, and report fake ones. Replies and posts are in Dutch: you draft them with our templates and AI, and a Dutch colleague checks them before they go live.

Track local rankings for a fixed set of searches and towns, and report monthly: profile views, calls, direction requests, website clicks, reviews, and what you will do next.

Ask before you change a business name, address, phone number or main category, and keep a log of every change you make.



REQUIRED SKILLS



1+ year managing Google Business Profiles for real shops, showrooms or local service companies, with results you can show.

You know Google’s guidelines for representing a business and you stay inside them: real names without added keywords, real addresses, one profile per real business.

Citation work: you can audit and clean up name, address and phone number across directories, and you choose relevant listings over large numbers.

Review management within the rules: no bought, traded or self-written reviews, and no asking only happy customers.

You can read a profile’s performance data and a local rank tracker, and report in plain numbers.

Careful and consistent. This is steady weekly work, and one wrong edit can get a profile suspended.

Comfortable working in a language you don’t speak: templates, AI drafts, and nothing public without a native check.

Good written English.



TOOLS WE USE



Experience with these is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



Google Business Profile (manager access) and Google Maps.

Apple Business Connect and Bing Places.

Semrush or Ahrefs, and Google Search Console.

A local rank tracker or citation tool, such as BrightLocal, Whitespark or Local Falcon. Tell us what you use.

Canva for post images.

Claude and DeepL for Dutch drafts; Bitrix24 for tasks.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with several locations or brands at once.

Experience with a rebrand, a duplicate or merge request, or getting a suspended profile reinstated.

Experience with European or Dutch directories.

Basics of LocalBusiness schema and location pages.

360° photos or virtual tours on a profile.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY



Part-time, about 6 hours per week, spread over at least two days so reviews don’t wait a full week. You meet with our SEO lead during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



You keep our listings accurate without being chased. You would rather ask than guess when an edit could put a profile at risk, and you never let unchecked Dutch go live. If you spot a way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$60/month. Part-time now, with room to grow within our findability team. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “PROXIMITY” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:



Describe one Google Business Profile you managed for a real shop, showroom or local service: what you changed in the first month, and what happened to calls, direction requests or rankings. Give numbers.

Two of our brands share one building: a bathroom showroom and a tile store. What do you check before d
 whether they get one Google Business Profile or two, and what would you never do to make them rank?

A competitor has far more Google reviews than we do, and a manager asks you for 50 new reviews this month. What do you do, and what do you refuse to do?

You don’t speak Dutch. A customer leaves a 2-star review in Dutch on our profile. Walk us through what you do, step by step.



Also include:



The public Google Maps links of one or two profiles you manage or have managed, with a short note on your part. Only share what already exists; please don’t build anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which days and hours (Philippine time) you are available.



We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

People research a new bathroom for months before they buy, and we want to be the source they find and trust.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You make sure our articles rank in Google and get quoted in AI answers (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity). Our market is Dutch, and you don’t need to speak Dutch: you do the research, the structure and the AI-assisted draft, and a Dutch editor checks every article before it goes live. You work from the keyword strategy and briefing template of our SEO lead, in a content pipeline with two approval gates: she approves the calendar before you draft, and the draft before it is published. Half of your time goes to our bathroom brand, Sanitairstudio; the other half to the wider BKG group. We start with two sites.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Research what Dutch homeowners actually ask: Semrush (Dutch database), Search Console, “People also ask”, and the questions in our own
 communities and showroom. Turn our SEO lead’s keyword clusters into outlines.

Draft with AI inside our content pipeline (Claude, an SEO scoring tool, WordPress drafts): you write the brief and the prompts, and you edit the draft until it is accurate, useful and on brief.

Structure every article for search and for AI answers: a direct answer first, question headings, short paragraphs, lists and tables, an FAQ, internal links and a clear next step for the reader.

Keep the facts straight: every fact, price and quote traces back to a source or to our own team. Customer reviews are quoted word for word. Nothing is invented.

Hand over each draft in WordPress with notes for the Dutch editor, process the corrections, and keep a list of recurring corrections so the next draft is better.

Update what we already have: use Search Console to find articles that rank on page two or have gone stale, and improve those before writing new ones.

Keep the content calendar up to date and report monthly: what was published or updated, rankings, clicks, and where we were cited in AI answers.



REQUIRED SKILLS



2+ years of SEO content work with results you can show: rankings, traffic, or articles cited in AI answers.

You understand search intent and structure: you can turn a keyword cluster into an outline that answers the question first.

You know how AI answers pick their sources (AEO/GEO): direct answers, clear entities, original facts and well-structured pages.

Fact discipline: you check claims, keep a source list, and never let an invented fact, price or quote through.

WordPress basics: drafts, headings, internal links, images with alt text, and the fields of an SEO plugin.

Comfortable producing content in a language you don’t speak, with a native editor checking every draft.

Excellent written English.



TOOLS WE USE

Claude for drafting, in a pipeline built on 
 and Google Sheets.

Semrush or Ahrefs, and Google Search Console.

A content-scoring tool such as NeuronWriter or Surfer.

WordPress with Rank Math.

DeepL and a grammar checker for back-translation and checks.

NICE TO HAVE

title: Creative Content Editor for Creator (Reels, YouTube Vlogs, Carousels)
description:
Creative Content Editor for Creator – Grow With Me 



Hi I'm Lauri - a content creator with an audience in Germany, and I'm now building my English-speaking audience in the US from the ground up. I'm looking for one creative person who wants to build this with me.



What the job really looks like:

I film everything. My footage folder gets a lot of new material all the time, and much of it is long, raw, unedited video. Your job is to go through it, find the gold and cut it out. That takes patience and a good eye, because the best 20 seconds are often hidden in a 40-minute clip.



From that footage you make:

 - Reels, TikToks and YouTube Shorts

- Longer YouTube vlogs

- Trend formats

- Occasional carousel posts (photos + text)



This is not a "cut exactly what I tell you" job. You pick the moments, you find the hooks, you bring the ideas.



How we work together:

 I'm looking for someone reliable who works closely with me but can also work on their own. You only edit, so your job is to choose well: pick the moments and angles where I look my best and leave out the rest. I often say or do something three or four times in a row. You find the best take and use that one.



Over time you learn what I like, take it on board and adapt your edits to it. I'm very open, and your own creativity is more than welcome. What matters to me is that you can take honest feedback well and use it to get better.



You:

- Have a sense of humor and know how to edit for it: timing, cuts, zooms, sound effects, text. My content should be fun to watch

- Have a good eye when selecting footage: you choose the most flattering moments and the best take

- Can spot the funny, surprising or relatable moment in long raw footage

- Edit short-form and long-form (CapCut or Premiere)

- Can build carousels (Canva is fine)

- Know what works for a US audience: trends, sounds, hooks and pacing

- Work independently without daily instructions

- Write good English, so captions and on-screen text are error-free



What you get:

- creative freedom 

- A long-term role with one creator, not one-off gigs

- Room to grow: we start with about 12 hours a week, and this can increase quickly if it goes well. Your pay and responsibility grow with it



About my content: I make travel and lifestyle content, with daily vlogs, some beauty and make-up, and a bit of fashion now and then. I travel all the time, so the footage is varied: new places, everyday moments, getting ready, trying things out. No two weeks look the same.



Details:

 - About 12 hours/week to start, flexible schedule (more hours possible soon)

- $5/hour, about $260/month to start

- English content

- Time tracked with TimeProof 

- Paid test task before hiring



To apply:

Put "Mango" in the subject line and send 2 short-form videos and 1 long-form video you edited. Tell me in 2-3 sentences which US creators you think edit well and why.



Can't wait to see what you create. Lauri

This means your earning potential is directly connected to your performance. The more successful appointments you create, the more you can earn.



For performance bonuses, appointments must meet the company’s qualification requirements, including patient attendance/completion when applicable.



We want motivated schedulers who are excited by the opportunity to earn additional compensation by helping keep our offices productive and our schedules full.



Main Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be to answer incoming patient calls and make outbound calls to schedule patients.



You will work with multiple scheduling opportunities, including:



New patient calls and inquiries

New patient scheduling

Patient reactivation

Patients who missed previous appointments

Patients who canceled and need to reschedule

Patients due for hygiene/cleaning appointments

Patients who completed SRP and are due for periodontal maintenance

Patients with treatment plans who have not scheduled

Patients who have already paid for treatment but do not have an appointment

Following up with patients to help fill openings in the schedule

Confirming and maintaining productive schedules

Helping the offices work toward zero missed calls

Dental Knowledge Is Required



This position requires more than excellent phone skills.



You must be able to speak confidently with patients about common dental procedures and appointments.



For example, you should understand or be able to confidently explain:



The difference between a regular prophylaxis/prophy and Scaling and Root Planing (SRP)

Why a patient may need SRP instead of a regular cleaning

What a patient can expect during common dental appointments

How many appointments may be required for a crown

Basic steps involved in crown treatment

Basic implant treatment processes

Pre-operative and post-operative appointments related to implants

Hygiene and periodontal maintenance appointments

Common dental terminology

How to schedule different dental procedures appropriately



We do not expect the scheduler to diagnose patients or answer questions that require a dentist or clinical provider. However, you should be able to confidently handle common patient questions without unnecessarily transferring every call.



Our goal is minimum unnecessary escalations and minimum unnecessary transfers to office managers.



Language Requirements



English is required.



Because you will be speaking with patients throughout the day, you must be able to communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.



You should be comfortable:



Answering patient calls in English

Explaining dental appointments and procedures clearly

Handling patient questions confidently

Communicating professionally through phone calls, text messages, and other patient communication channels

Understanding patients with different speaking styles and accents

Providing a high level of customer service in English



Spanish is a plus. Bilingual English/Spanish candidates are encouraged to apply, but Spanish is not required for consideration.



You Are Part of the Dental Office



We do not want our patients to feel like they are speaking with an outside call center.



You should never approach a patient conversation with:



“This is the call center. Let me transfer you to the office.”



You are part of the office team.



We want our patients to feel that they are speaking directly with a knowledgeable member of their dental office who understands their needs and can help them.



The scheduler is one of the most important roles in our organization because you:



Create the appointments that fill the doctors’ schedules

Help patients receive the treatment they need

Create the patient's first impression of our practice

Help prevent missed opportunities

Support the doctors, hygienists, managers, and clinical teams

Help maintain healthy and productive schedules

What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate will have:



Fluent spoken and written English — required

Spanish — a plus

Previous dental scheduling, dental receptionist, dental call center, or dental patient coordinator experience

Good knowledge of dental terminology

Understanding of common dental procedures

Experience scheduling dental appointments

Strong customer service skills

Confidence speaking with patients

Excellent telephone etiquette

Ability to explain information clearly and professionally

Strong follow-up skills

Ability to handle objections and encourage patients to schedule

High motivation and a performance-driven mindset

Ability to work independently

Reliability and consistency

Strong attention to detail

Ability to learn our systems and protocols quickly

A positive, team-oriented attitude

Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:



Answer calls consistently

Help us achieve as close to zero missed calls as possible

Create quality appointments

Convert patient inquiries into scheduled appointments

Follow up consistently with unscheduled patients

Keep schedules full

Communicate professionally with patients

Reduce unnecessary transfers

Understand dental appointment types

Work as a true member of the dental office team



This is a great opportunity for someone who already understands dentistry and enjoys speaking with patients, scheduling treatment, and working toward performance goals.



How to Apply



Please send your application to:





Please include:

Your resume

Your previous dental experience

The dental software you have used

Your experience scheduling dental procedures

A short explanation of the difference between a prophy and an SRP

Your experience handling incoming and outbound patient calls

Your English proficiency level

Whether you speak Spanish and your proficiency level, if applicable

Your available working hours

Your internet speed and computer specifications



Important: Strong dental knowledge and fluent English are important requirements for this position. Applicants without sufficient dental knowledge may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a real part of the Smile Group dental team, provide an excellent patient experience, and take advantage of a performance-based compensation structure with the opportunity to increase their earnings through successful scheduling.

title: Graphic Designer – Performance Creative (Remote)
description:
Type of Work: Full-time

 Salary: $800-$1500/month DOE

 Hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm EST (exact hours flexible)

About the Role

We're looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our performance creative team, with a focus on designing high-performing static and motion ads for paid social. You'll take creative briefs and brand assets and turn them into polished, scroll-stopping designs built to convert.

This role reports to Kate (Creative Operations Manager) and Ally (Senior Designer) on the performance creative team.

About Us

Grüns is a modern nutrition gummy brand focused on simplifying wellness through delicious, functional, science-backed products. Our portfolio includes Grüns, Grüns Kids, Immün, Nütrops, and Jüced. We advertise mainly on Meta (FB/IG), TikTok, and YouTube, and our creative strategy relies on fast experimentation and a wide range of concepts.

What You'll Do



Design performance static ads across Grüns, Grüns Kids, Immün, Nütrops, and Jüced for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other paid channels

Turn creative briefs and references into polished, platform-optimized statics, carousels, and GIFs

Build comparison ads, benefit callouts, and other direct-response formats with clear visual hierarchy

Composite product renders into realistic scenes, with consistent lighting, shadows, and perspective

Refresh proven concepts with new layouts and angles to keep top-performing ads from wearing out

Create simple animated assets and GIFs for paid social placements

Execute revisions quickly and accurately based on feedback from Creative Strategists and stakeholders

Maintain brand consistency across five distinct brand identities

Manage multiple assets at once across active production cycles

Organize and maintain design files and project assets according to team DAM and file structure standards

What We're Looking For



Strong proficiency in Photoshop and Figma; Illustrator and After Effects a plus

A strong feel for performance creative: what makes a static stop the scroll and communicate one clear idea fast

Strong typography, layout, and composition skills

Photo manipulation and compositing skills: able to place product into scenes that feel real

Experience designing paid social ads, preferably for DTC or e-commerce brands

Able to work efficiently in a high-volume environment and hit turnaround timelines consistently

Comfortable working across multiple brand guidelines without losing quality

Experience with AI-assisted design tools a strong plus

Detail-oriented with clean file management habits

Receptive to feedback and comfortable working within a structured review process

How to Apply

Please send your resume and a portfolio link that includes paid social or performance ad work. Shortlisted candidates will get a paid-social design test assignment to complete within 7 days.

Why This Role Matters

Static ads are one of our highest-volume creative formats and a key lever for testing new concepts quickly. You'll be turning briefs into tested, scalable ads, directly contributing to how our brands grow across paid channels.
