title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer
description:
Position Summary

Ashoori Law is a U.S. immigration law firm based in Los Angeles. It works with a national network of independent immigration attorneys. We're hiring a Video & Graphics to own the visual side of our marketing, from the weekly YouTube video to the graphics that go with every post.



In this role, you'll edit one long-form YouTube video a week and cut it into short clips for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. You'll also design the thumbnails, social graphics, carousels and blog images for our website and social channels. You'll work in Premiere Pro (or similar), Photoshop and Canva, and you'll build and maintain the templates the marketing team uses for everyday content.



Because we’re an immigration law firm, every video and graphic goes through an accuracy and compliance review before it's published. The right person takes detailed feedback well, applies edits precisely, and makes educational immigration content clear and engaging without overstating anything. You'll report to the Marketing Manager and work closely with the content, social, SEO and web development team.



Core Responsibilities

Video Editing

Edit long-form YouTube video per week, turning scripts, raw footage, graphics and other source material into a polished final production.

Cut each long-form video into 3-5 short clips for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, with captions, a strong opening hook and a closing call-to-action card.

Edit scripted short-form videos, client testimonial videos and firm introduction videos.

Add captions, lower thirds, on-screen text, b-roll, motion graphics, intros, outros and end cards, and handle audio cleanup and color correction for a consistent, professional look.

Apply reviewer notes precisely and completely, and provide an updated transcript after each revision round.

Keep project files, raw footage and final exports organized in the shared drive.

Deliver high-quality work on a consistent weekly schedule, with quick turnaround on revisions.

Graphic Design

Design YouTube thumbnails, Reel and TikTok covers, and testimonial video thumbnails.

Create social graphics and carousels for Instagram,
 and 
 from blog posts, FAQs and approved client reviews.

Produce blog featured images and text-based infographics and tables for the website, optimized for web performance.

Build and maintain a Canva template library so the marketing team can produce recurring content quickly and consistently.

Support the firm's brand refresh and website redesign with visual assets, including photo retouching and consistent backgrounds on attorney headshots.

Editorial & Brand Standards

Use sound editorial judgment to create content that is clear, accurate and engaging for people navigating immigration questions.

Make sure all videos and graphics follow Ashoori Law's brand guidelines and the legal advertising rules for law firms.

Submit all work through the firm's accuracy and compliance review before publishing, and implement required changes promptly.

Follow YouTube and social platform community guidelines and content policies.

Work with the marketing, content, social, SEO and web development teams so content meets creative and strategic goals.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Stay current on YouTube and short-form editing best practices, thumbnail trends, audience behavior and new content formats.

Review high-performing immigration and legal education content for format and style ideas, without copying anyone's wording or creative.

Use performance data (click-through rate, watch time, engagement) to improve thumbnails, hooks and pacing over time.

Suggest improvements to editing workflows, templates and production efficiency.



Qualifications

3+ years of experience of professional video editing and graphic design experience

A portfolio showing edited YouTube videos, short-form vertical videos, thumbnails and social graphics or carousels.

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro), Adobe Photoshop and Canva.

Experience editing educational, talking-head or explainer content for YouTube.

Working knowledge of platform formats and specs, including 16:9, 9:16 and 4:5, safe zones and caption styles.

Strong attention to detail, especially with on-screen text, spelling and accuracy.

Ability to take detailed feedback and implement revisions precisely and on deadline.

Strong organization and project management skills; able to juggle a weekly video alongside ongoing design requests.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Reliable internet connection and availability during PST business hours.



Preferred

Experience creating content for law firms, legal media, or other regulated industries such as finance or healthcare.

Familiarity with YouTube Studio analytics and thumbnail testing.

Adobe After Effects or similar motion graphics experience.

Adobe Illustrator 



What Success Looks Like

One polished YouTube video and its short-form clips delivered on schedule every week.

Thumbnails and graphics that are on-brand, consistent and improving in click-through rate and engagement over time.

Reviewer notes applied correctly the first time, with fewer compliance revisions as you learn the firm's standards.

A working template library the marketing team relies on for everyday content.

Multiple projects and deadlines handled with strong organization and attention to detail.

Effective collaboration with the content, social, SEO and web development team.

New editing techniques, formats and creative ideas that keep Ashoori Law's content clear, competitive and engaging.

title: Copywriter (CRO & UX)
description:
We're a small web dev & marketing agency in The Hague, Netherlands.



We are looking for a creative copywriter with CRO experience who writes ICP- focused copy across the funnel.



Your main goal is to turn website visitors into leads for local service and other businesses.



If you have a genuine passion for writing and are good with data, this role is for you.



What you'll do



- Write conversion-focused copy for landing pages

- Improve lead forms, CTAs and the mobile experience

- Rewrite existing pages to make the offer more persuasive

- Analyze user behavior via GA4 and Microsoft Clarity to find where visitors drop off

- Plan page layouts and UX improvements: write briefs for our web developer and give feedback to a web designer in Figma

- Set up split tests and document the results

- Log key changes in the shared task sheet of our marketing team (what was done, why, where)



Tracking your results



- Landing page conversion and engagement data in GA4 and Microsoft Clarity

- Leads data (calls and forms) in WhatConverts

- CTR and CVR data in Google Ads



A note on Dutch language



Dutch is not required. You will write in English and use Claude to translate into natural Dutch. We will show you how to do it.



You need to be a skilled writer and be comfortable using AI tools strategically and checking their output.



Who you'll work with



You'll report directly to the agency director and work closely with our performance marketer, web designer, web developer and SEO specialist. 



We are looking for someone who:



- Has 2+ years of experience writing long-form conversion-focused copy

- Writes for a human first, then the algorithm

- Is sharp with analysis of the market and target audience data

- Has a good understanding of the sales process

- Has excellent English

- Has a portfolio of landing pages and before/after results

- Has a good understanding of UX basics: page structure, visual hierarchy and mobile-first design

- Is comfortable analyzing data in GA4 and Clarity and turning it into test ideas

- Writes the copy himself/herself, with AI supporting research, editing and translation

- Has experience with Figma or Miro (for feedback and wireframes)

- Is comfortable managing multiple projects and adapting to clients' needs



Nice to have, but not required:



- Experience with WordPress

- Experience with Google Ads

- Experience with basic on-page SEO

- Experience with the Dutch or another European market



Cooperation structure



- 20-30 hours a week

- Rate: 10 USD per hour or monthly retainer (negotiable)

- Paid monthly 



We work on Amsterdam time. Regular working hours are 10:00 to 18:00, from Mon to Fri. You need to be available for at least 4 hours within this window 5 days a week.



To apply



Send your CV and 2 examples of landing pages you improved, with the analysis of how your copy builds trust with the target audience.



Clear before/after numbers are a big plus (e.g. conversion rate, engagement rate, bounce rate, leads, revenue).



Explain (in short) how you d
 what to change on a page to improve conversion.



No need to write a long cover letter. Just be real and let your work speak for itself. Looms and Miro links are welcome.

title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant
description:
Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant

Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Accounting Experience Required



About the Role



We are seeking a strong, commercially minded and highly organised Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant to take ownership of the internal finance function for a growing Australian group of businesses.

This is a hands-on, all-rounder accounting role. You will be responsible for the complete finance cycle — from day-to-day transactions and reconciliations through to month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, job costing, profitability analysis and KPI reporting.



You will also take ownership of important group financial administration, including insurance, licences and other renewals, and provide confidential financial support to the Founder.



This is not a purely transactional bookkeeping role, nor is it a position for someone who only reviews work prepared by others.



We need someone who can personally get into the detail, make sure the numbers are right, analyse what they mean and give management clear financial visibility.



You will work closely with the Founder and management team and play an important role in improving profitability, cash flow, financial controls and decision-making across the Group.



Key Responsibilities



1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance



Take ownership of the day-to-day internal accounting function across multiple entities, including:

• Bank and credit card reconciliations

• Accounts payable and accounts receivable oversight

• Payroll and payroll-related reconciliations

• Intercompany transactions and reconciliations

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Fixed asset and accounting schedules

• Correct transaction coding and supporting documentation

• Investigation and correction of accounting discrepancies

• Maintenance of accurate and up-to-date financial records

• Identification of unusual transactions, errors and control weaknesses



You will be expected to remain hands-on and capable of completing detailed accounting work yourself when required.



2. Month-End Closing & Management Accounts



Take full ownership of the month-end process, including:

• Month-end journals

• Accruals and prepayments

• Payroll reconciliations

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Intercompany reconciliations

• Revenue and expense cut-off

• Review of P&L and balance sheet

• Investigation of unusual movements

• Preparation of management accounts

• Month-end management commentary

• Ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time



The successful candidate should be capable of independently driving month-end close without needing to be reminded of each task.



3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

• Prepare and maintain annual budgets

• Maintain rolling forecasts

• Prepare and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast

• Monitor actual results against budget

• Analyse and explain material variances

• Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential cash flow risks

• Monitor working capital

• Provide management with early warning of potential financial issues

• Recommend practical actions based on financial results



4. Job Costing & Profitability Analysis



A major responsibility of this role is to establish strong visibility over profitability across the Group.

This includes:

• Gross profit by client

• Gross profit by employee

• Gross profit by team/division

• Gross profit by business entity

• Client revenue versus labour cost

• Actual hours/cost versus client budget

• Employee utilisation and productivity

• Revenue and cost per employee

• Identification of underperforming clients, jobs or service areas

• Identification of scope creep and cost overruns

• Development and continuous improvement of job costing methodologies

• Recommendations to improve margins and operational efficiency



The successful candidate must be able to go beyond producing numbers and explain what the numbers mean, why performance has changed and what management should investigate or change.



5. KPI Dashboard & Performance Reporting



Take ownership of the financial KPI and management reporting framework across the Group.

Responsibilities include:

• Develop and maintain management KPI dashboards

• Ensure KPI data is accurate, reconciled and supported by reliable source data

• Monitor revenue, gross profit and GP%

• Monitor profitability by client, employee, team and business entity

• Monitor client budget versus actual hours/cost

• Monitor employee utilisation and productivity

• Track budget versus actual performance

• Monitor cash flow and working capital

• Monitor accounts receivable and overdue debts

• Maintain historical KPI trends

• Identify adverse trends and exceptions requiring management attention

• Investigate the underlying causes of financial underperformance

• Provide concise management commentary and recommendations

• Continuously improve and automate KPI reporting where practical



The objective is to give management timely, accurate and actionable visibility over the financial health and performance of the Group.



This position is expected to highlight problems proactively rather than simply produce reports.



6. Group Finance & Corporate Administration



Take ownership of important recurring financial and administrative obligations, including:

• Insurance renewals

• Professional and business licence renewals

• Registrations and other recurring compliance renewals

• Finance and loan documentation

• Subscription and contract renewals

• Maintaining a centralised renewal and compliance calendar

• Ensuring deadlines are identified well in advance

• Obtaining information and quotations where required

• Maintaining appropriate supporting documentation

• Escalating matters requiring management approval



An important expectation of this position is that key financial and administrative obligations are proactively managed without relying on the Founder to remember or continually follow them up.



7. Founder / Personal Finance Support



Provide highly confidential financial and administrative support to the Founder, including:

• Personal cash flow and financial reporting

• Investment and property-related accounting records

• Loan and finance schedules

• Personal financial administration

• Coordination of information required for tax and financial planning

• Maintaining accurate records across personal and business financial matters



A very high level of confidentiality, integrity and discretion is essential.



8. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Improve finance processes, controls and reporting systems

• Reduce unnecessary manual work

• Identify opportunities for automation

• Use technology and AI appropriately to improve finance efficiency

• Ensure automated reports and processes remain accurate and properly controlled

• Document important finance processes

• Build scalable finance systems capable of supporting continued Group growth



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is an experienced all-rounder accountant who can work confidently from detailed transactions through to management-level financial analysis.



You should have:

• Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent

• CPA/CA qualification or progress towards qualification highly regarded

• Strong Australian accounting experience

• Strong management accounting experience

• Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close

• Budgeting and cash flow forecasting experience

• Strong job costing and profitability analysis skills

• Advanced Excel skills

• Strong Xero experience

• Excellent reconciliation and problem-solving skills

• Experience working across multiple entities

• Strong attention to detail

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Excellent organisational and deadline-management skills

• High level of confidentiality and professional judgement

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision



The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions

• Is naturally organised and follows matters through to completion

• Notices when numbers do not make sense and investigates why

• Can move comfortably between detailed accounting and commercial analysis

• Is willing to remain hands-on

• Can prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment

• Builds systems and controls rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems

• Is proactive about upcoming deadlines and financial risks

• Communicates issues early rather than waiting until they become urgent

• Can respectfully challenge numbers, assumptions and processes

• Looks continuously for opportunities to automate and improve finance processes

• Understands that good internal finance is not simply about producing accounts — it is about giving management visibility, control and actionable information



Key Measures of Success



Success in this position will include:

• Accurate and timely month-end closing

• Reliable management accounts

• Fully reconciled balance sheet accounts

• Reliable budget versus actual reporting

• Accurate and regularly maintained cash flow forecasting

• Clear visibility of gross profit by client, employee, team and business area

• Reliable KPI dashboards

• Early identification and escalation of financial risks

• Strong accounts receivable and working capital visibility

• No missed insurance, licence or important renewal deadlines

• Improved finance processes, controls and automation

• Reduced reliance on the Founder for routine finance administration and follow-up



The Opportunity



This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the internal finance function of a growing Australian business group.

For the right person, the position has significant potential to develop into a broader finance leadership role as the Group continues to grow.

title: Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist
description:
Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist



Remote — Philippines | Lyons Cards LLC



ABOUT LYONS CARDS



Lyons Cards LLC is a fast-growing, family-owned sports-card and live-commerce company based in St. Louis, Missouri.



We are building a modern sports-card business around:



* Live breaks

* Premium singles

* PSA/BGS/SGC graded cards

* Sealed sports-card products

* Repacks

* Shopify / 

* Whatnot live commerce

* Online marketplace sales

* Customer engagement

* Strategic inventory management



Our primary sports are football and basketball, with select baseball inventory.



We are looking for a highly capable Philippines-based team member who can help us turn inventory into revenue while keeping our online listings, customer inquiries and card inventory organized.



⸻



POSITION



Sports Cards Sales & Inventory Specialist



This is not simply a data-entry job.



This person will help Lyons Cards with:



CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT + SALES + INVENTORY + LISTINGS + MARKETPLACE SUPPORT



The ideal person is extremely organized, fast, commercially minded, comfortable learning new software, and able to communicate with U.S. customers at a very high level.



⸻



ENGLISH REQUIREMENT — C2 MASTERY



C2-level English mastery is required.



You must be able to:



* Write naturally to U.S. customers

* Understand casual American English and slang

* Respond professionally without sounding scripted

* Handle negotiations

* Understand detailed instructions

* Recognize when a customer is serious versus simply asking questions

* Escalate unusual situations clearly

* Communicate confidently with management



Your written English should be nearly indistinguishable from that of a highly proficient native-level business communicator.



Please do not apply if your English level is below C2/near-native professional proficiency.



⸻



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. CUSTOMER / MARKETPLACE SALES SUPPORT



Monitor and respond to customer inquiries across approved Lyons Cards channels.



These may include:



* 
 / Shopify

*

* Whatnot

* eBay

* Other approved marketplace channels

* Customer email

* Social comments and direct messages



Responsibilities include:



* Answering product questions

* Responding to comments

* Responding to pricing inquiries

* Handling offers

* Following up with interested customers

* Helping convert inquiries into sales

* Providing basic shipping/order information

* Maintaining a professional Lyons Cards voice



The objective is not simply to answer messages.



The objective is to help produce sales.



⸻



2. OFFER / NEGOTIATION MANAGEMENT



Lyons Cards will establish pricing and negotiation guidelines.



You will be expected to:



* Know the current asking price

* Understand approved negotiation ranges

* Respond to reasonable offers

* Recognize serious buyers

* Avoid unnecessarily discounting inventory

* Escalate offers that fall outside your approved authority



Example:



If a card is listed at $500 and an offer falls within an approved range, you may be authorized to continue the negotiation.



If an offer falls below the approved range or involves an important card, immediately send the offer to Connor Lyons for a decision.



Do not guess.



Do not make unauthorized discounts.



⸻



3. CARD INVENTORY INTAKE



A major responsibility will be helping Lyons Cards rapidly load inventory into Card Dealer Pro, our inventory management system.



We are intentionally simplifying this process.



The goal is:



GET THE CARD INTO THE SYSTEM QUICKLY AND ACCURATELY.



You may receive batches of card photographs from Connor or another Lyons Cards team member.



Example:



Connor sends you 20–50 card photographs and basic instructions.



You then create/import the batch and make sure those cards are properly entered into inventory.



⸻



4. TWO PRIMARY INVENTORY BATCHES



Inventory will generally begin in two major categories:



GRADED / SLABS



Examples:



* PSA

* BGS / Beckett

* SGC

* Other approved grading companies



Important information may include:



* Player

* Year

* Set

* Card number

* Parallel

* Serial number

* Grading company

* Grade

* Certification number

* Image

* SKU

* Physical location

* Selling price

* Status



RAW CARDS



Raw cards are cards that have not been professionally graded.



Information may include:



* Player

* Year

* Set

* Card number

* Parallel

* Serial number

* Image

* SKU

* Physical location

* Selling price

* Status



We do NOT want unnecessary data entry that slows down the operation.



Accuracy and speed are both important.



⸻



5. INVENTORY STATUS / USE



Cards may be assigned different jobs inside the company.



Examples:



AVAILABLE

Normal inventory available to sell.



HOLD

Do not sell without management approval.



REPACK

Reserved or considered for Lyons Cards repack products.



GRADE

Raw card intended for professional grading.



REVIEW

Management decision required.



You must make sure special inventory is not a
 sold.



⸻



6. PRICING SUPPORT



Market value — not historical purchase cost — drives our selling decisions.



Management will establish pricing using current card-market information and revenue-management principles.



You may be given a price directly by Connor or management.



Example:



Connor sends:



Card photos + $349 list price + AVAILABLE



Your responsibility is to enter the cards correctly and make sure the correct selling price/status appears in the system.



As you develop, you may assist with basic market research and comparable sales.



Final pricing authority remains with Lyons Cards management unless otherwise delegated.



⸻



7. SHOPIFY / E-COMMERCE SUPPORT



Card Dealer Pro is the primary inventory system.



Shopify / 
 is the consumer storefront.



You may help:



* Review products before they go live

* Verify images

* Verify titles

* Verify pricing

* Confirm availability

* Correct listing errors

* Organize collections

* Monitor customer inquiries

* Identify products that need updated pricing

* Ensure sold inventory is properly handled across channels



You should become comfortable working inside modern e-commerce software.



⸻



8. WHATNOT / LIVE-COMMERCE SUPPORT



Lyons Cards is building a significant live-commerce business on Whatnot.



You may assist with:



* Show listings

* Product setup

* Customer messages

* Auction preparation

* Post-show order review

* Buyer questions

* Sales follow-up

* Analytics

* Inventory reconciliation



You will not automatically be responsible for hosting shows.



Your job is to help the hosts and management operate efficiently behind the scenes.



⸻



9. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE



Lyons Cards is built around a simple principle:



WE ARE NOT TRYING TO WIN ONE TRANSACTION.



WE ARE TRYING TO WIN THE CUSTOMER.



We expect:



* Fast responses

* Professional communication

* Honest descriptions

* No misleading claims

* No aggressive pressure

* No unauthorized discounts

* Strong follow-up

* Respect for collectors

* Immediate escalation when something appears wrong



Customers should feel that Lyons Cards is organized, responsive and trustworthy.



⸻



10. SOFTWARE / SYSTEMS



You should be comfortable learning and using systems such as:



* Card Dealer Pro

* Shopify

* Whatnot Seller Hub

* eBay

* Google Sheets

* Google Drive

* Email

* Messaging platforms

* Basic image/file management

* Marketplace dashboards



Training will be provided on Lyons Cards-specific processes.



You must be comfortable learning technology quickly.



⸻



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* C2 / near-native English proficiency — REQUIRED

* Excellent written communication

* Strong attention to detail

* Fast computer skills

* Comfortable working with large numbers of images/files

* Strong organizational ability

* Reliable internet connection

* Ability to follow pricing/negotiation rules

* Strong judgment

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to recognize when management approval is required

* Comfortable learning new software

* Reliable and responsive

* Commercial/sales mindset



⸻



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



* Sports cards

* Trading cards

* Whatnot

* eBay

* Shopify

* Online selling

* Marketplace customer service

* Sales negotiation

* Inventory management

* PSA/BGS/SGC cards

* Sports knowledge

* E-commerce

* Live commerce



Sports-card expertise is preferred but not mandatory if you are highly intelligent, commercially minded and able to learn quickly.



⸻



IMPORTANT PERSONALITY TRAITS



We want someone who is:



* Fast

* Accurate

* Resourceful

* Commercially minded

* Calm under pressure

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable asking questions

* Not afraid to make decisions within established authority

* Able to recognize when NOT to make a decision

* Interested in becoming an important member of a growing company



We do not want someone who simply waits for instructions all day.



⸻



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED



This role will eventually be measured on things such as:



* Response time

* Customer inquiries handled

* Sales conversions

* Offers converted into sales

* Inventory entered per hour

* Listing accuracy

* Inventory errors

* Pricing/listing errors

* Customer satisfaction

* Speed of inventory activation

* Marketplace follow-up

* Revenue supported



The ultimate goal is:



GET INVENTORY ACTIVE → GET IT IN FRONT OF CUSTOMERS → HELP TURN IT INTO REVENUE.



⸻



WORKING WITH MANAGEMENT



You will work closely with:



Connor Lyons

Owner / Operator / Product & Card Lead



Connor will provide card/product knowledge, pricing guidance and decisions on offers requiring approval.



You will also work with Lyons Cards management, operations, social-media and website personnel.



Clear communication is critical.



When escalating something, do not simply say:



“Customer has a question.”



Instead say:



Card: [exact card]

Listed Price: $___

Customer Offer: $___

Relevant information: ___

Decision Needed: Accept / Counter / Decline



Management should be able to understand the situation immediately.



⸻



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This role is being created while Lyons Cards is building its operating platform.



A strong performer may grow into responsibility for:



* Marketplace sales

* E-commerce management

* Inventory operations

* Pricing support

* Sales management

* Customer service leadership

* Live-commerce administration

* Marketplace analytics

* Team supervision



We want someone who can grow with the business.



⸻



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit.

2. Your English proficiency level.

3. Previous experience with online selling, Shopify, eBay, marketplaces or customer service.

4. Any experience with sports cards or collectibles.

5. Your available working hours in Philippine time.

6. Your computer/internet setup.

7. Your expected hourly/monthly compensation.

8. Answer this scenario:



A sports card is listed for $500. A customer messages offering $375. You have been authorized to negotiate only down to $450 without management approval. What would you do, and what would you send to Connor?



9. Begin your application with the words:



BUILT FOR COLLECTORS



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.



⸻



LYONS CARDS LLC



Sports Cards • Breaks • Repacks • Collectibles



Family-Owned • Live from St. Louis



Built for Collectors.

title: AI-First Video Ad Creator | Dog Supplement Brand
description:
Hi, nice to meet you! 👋



We are not looking for someone who just wants another editing gig. We are looking for one editor who wants to get really good at making video ads that sell, and who wants to grow with us over the long term.



We are a small team building a dog supplement brand 🐶 for the US market. We move fast and test a lot. Every week we run new video ads on Meta, all in English.



We provide the ad concepts and deliver clear briefs, with references where possible. What we need is an editor who turns our ideas into finished ads we can run right away.





🎯 THIS IS NOT A NORMAL EDITING JOB

We don't need someone who just puts clips in order. When you open a new task, you should ask yourself:

- Does this hook catch the viewer in the first second?

- Is every clip good enough to run?

- Is anything cut off in Feed, Stories or Reels?

- Is the file named correctly, or will anything cause issues?

- Are there any AI errors in the footage, like a sixth finger?



Your job is not only to edit what you get. Your job is to deliver ads we can trust without checking every frame.





🎬 WHAT YOU WILL DO

You get ideas, references, the copy and a written spec. Sometimes we explain it in a short Loom video. You create content with AI. In the end, you deliver finished ads that are ready to run.



- Create stunning B-roll with AI video models

- Turn ad concepts into finished ads for
 and Instagram

- Think about hooks that CATCH the viewer

- Add subtitles and on-screen elements

- Follow the naming convention we give you





🔍 WE WANT SOMEONE WHO CARES ABOUT DETAILS

- If a clip has an AI error, like a strange face or a broken dog paw, you notice.

- If text sits where Instagram will cover it, you move it.

- If a spec is unclear, you ask before you start.

- If you think a cut would work better another way, tell us and show us.



We don't want someone who waits for us to find the mistakes.





📈 YOUR GROWTH PATH

This is a full time role, 40 hours per week. The better and more reliable your work, the faster you grow with us, with higher pay and more responsibility.





💰 PAYMENT = BASE + BONUS

- Monthly base: $1,000–$1,500 USD

- Performance bonus on top, paid monthly. It depends on the quality and reliability of your work and how well your ads perform.

- Payment through Payoneer (EasyPay), Wise or another method you prefer.



We always pay on time. No chasing invoices, no delays, no excuses. You focus on great ads, we make sure your payment arrives on time. If you prefer, we can start with a weekly payment.





🙋 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Highly experienced video ad editor. Most of our ads are 30 to 45 seconds, some are longer.

- Hands-on experience with AI video models. This is a must.

- You fully understand Meta safe zones. You know what gets cut in Feed, Stories and Reels and place everything correctly without being told.

- A sharp eye for mistakes in footage, both AI-generated and real.

- Good written English.

- Reliable delivery times.



We don't require a specific editing program. Use whatever you are fast in.



⭐ Experience with D2C / supplement ads is a strong plus.





🛠️ HOW WE WORK

- Full time, 40 hours per week

- Tools: Slack, Asana, Google Drive. A clear structure is important.

- We work async. We are based in Europe (CET/CEST), no fixed hours needed.

- No agencies and no outsourcing. We want to work with you directly.





👋 YOU TALK TO ME, NOT TO A BOT

I'm Leon, the founder of Holy Pup. I read every application myself. If your portfolio is a fit, you will talk to me directly in a short video call. A real human, no recruiter, no AI screening.





🤝 HOW WE HIRE

Application on our careers page → I review your portfolio personally → 15 minute video call with me → Paid test project → Ongoing work



There is no unpaid trial task. Your portfolio and application are your first trial.





✍️ HOW TO APPLY

Apply on our careers page, it takes about 5 minutes:

👉 
/jobs/ai-video-editor



Please have ready:

- 3 to 5 video ads you edited, with the AI ones marked

- One short line per ad on what you did

- The editing and AI tools you use

- Optional, but a big plus: a short video intro (Loom or YouTube, max 2 minutes)



If your portfolio convinces me, I will invite you to a 15 minute video call so we can get to know each other. If we can see ourselves working together, we will start with a paid test project.



If it is not a fit, I will tell you too. You will hear from me within 3 days either way.



Applications only through our careers page. Applications via
 or chat are not considered.



Thanks, and I'm looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Mobile Developer (iOS & Android), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. We build and run native mobile apps that record audio, keep data safe on the device, upload in the background and talk to our own APIs. We are hiring a mobile developer to own them.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You own both native apps end to end, from a ticket to a release in the stores. The same codebase ships as several branded products on both platforms, so one change usually lands in more than one repo. The apps are multilingual, with Dutch and English today and more languages likely. You work with a small team in the Netherlands and use AI coding tools as a normal part of your workflow.



- Build features: take a feature from description to a finished screen that looks like it belongs in the app and feels native on iOS and Android

- Keep recording reliable: long audio recordings, background uploads, interruptions and OS watchdog kills are the hard part of this job

- Release to the stores: handle signing, TestFlight and internal testing tracks, review submissions, screenshots and release notes, for every branded app

- Fix what breaks: take a Sentry issue, reproduce it, fix it and ship it

- Modernize step by step: move the apps forward (for example from UIKit to SwiftUI) without a rewrite

- Localize: keep string tables in sync across platforms and make every screen work in every language



What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 5+ years of native mobile development in Swift and Kotlin, with at least one app you took from first commit to a live store listing and kept alive through updates

- Hands-on with App Store Connect and Google Play Console: certificates, provisioning, app signing, TestFlight, internal testing tracks and review submissions hold no surprises

- REST API integration end to end, including auth flows, token refresh, error handling and versioned contracts

- Audio capture or other long-running background work on at least one platform, and the drive to be equally strong on the other

- Local persistence, encryption and migrations, in whichever database you have used

- Comfortable in a reactive codebase (Rx-style or similar)

- Everyday Git: branches, rebases, pull requests and reviewing other people's work

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal (you do not need to speak Dutch)

- You read crash reports before feature requests



Also important:

- Design minded: you work from a brand guideline and the existing screens, have a good eye for spacing, type, color, dark mode and iPad layouts, and know the Apple and Material conventions well enough to choose between them on purpose. You are happy to show two quick variants and take feedback.

- Localization: you have shipped an app in more than one language, and know how to handle text that grows and format dates and numbers per locale.



Nice-to-have:

- SwiftUI, Combine, Jetpack Compose or Kotlin coroutines, so you can help us move the apps forward

- OAuth and Microsoft sign-in

- Your own iPhone, iPad, Android phone and Mac, so you can test on real devices from day one

- Experience using AI tools like Claude or Claude Code in your work



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar tools to write code, migrate old code or track down crashes, tell us how, including where they don't help. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Real ownership: you own both native apps, from ticket to store release

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Freedom to propose: if something should be done differently, we want to hear it

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



Our mobile stack



We care about depth on both platforms more than any specific library. If you know the modern equivalents (Combine, Compose, coroutines, Room, SQLDelight, SPM), you will pick these up quickly.



- iOS: Swift, UIKit with a SwiftUI migration under way, Rx-style reactive code, Realm, Moya, CocoaPods

- Android: Kotlin, Fragments and XML layouts, Rx-style reactive code, Realm, Retrofit, Gradle

- Shared: REST APIs with OAuth and Microsoft sign-in, Sentry, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, GitHub, Linear



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into mobile development.

2. An app you shipped: Walk us through an app you took from first commit to the stores. What was the hardest part of getting it released and keeping it running?

3. A hard crash you fixed: Tell us about the most complex crash or background issue you tracked down. Why was it hard to reproduce, and how did you fix it?

4. AI in your work: How do you use AI coding assistants in your mobile work today? Where do they help, and where do they not?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application



Send the following to 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: App Store or Google Play links to apps you built, GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile



 subject: "Mobile Developer Application - [Your Name]"



What happens next



1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates move to a technical evaluation with our Head of Technology

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



Who should apply



Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like owning an app end to end, including the store releases

- Care about how a screen looks and feels, not just whether it works

- Are curious about AI and how it changes mobile development



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Have only built apps with cross-platform frameworks, not native Swift or Kotlin



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.



MSTR,

- Coach agents on their mistakes and help onboard new hires

- E-commerce CS experience, ideally in fashion/apparel, where return and refund requests are high

- Dropshipping experience

- Experience working with a China-based supplier or sourcing agent

- Excellent written English

- Reliable internet and a backup power plan

title: Client Success & Communications Coordinator
description:
Part-Time / Flexible | Long-Term | UK Google Ads Agency



Hi, I'm Ryan, founder of a UK-based Google Ads agency working primarily with e-commerce businesses.



I'm building a small specialist team and looking for an exceptional Client Success & Communications Coordinator to become the communication link between our clients and the team.



This is not a full-time role, and it's not a traditional VA position where you'll simply wait for me to give you tasks. I'm looking for someone proactive, extremely organised and comfortable taking ownership.



What you'll be responsible for:

- Monitoring and responding to client
s

- Monitoring our Fiverr inbox and responding quickly to new enquiries

- Handling routine client communication and follow-ups

- Updating client information, audit briefs and tasks inside Slack

- Making sure the right information reaches the right team member

- Coordinating with our Google Ads Account Manager, Audit Specialist and Research Specialist

- Chasing missing information or client assets without waiting to be asked

- Identifying anything that genuinely needs Ryan's attention and escalating it clearly

- Potentially helping with client video reports in the future



You will not be expected to manage Google Ads yourself. Your job is to make sure communication is excellent, and nothing falls through the cracks.



The person I'm looking for:

- Exceptional written English is essential.

- Most of our communication should read as though it has been written by someone in the UK. You should be comfortable with British English spelling, grammar and natural conversational language, rather than American English or overly formal/corporate customer-service language.



I'm specifically looking for someone who:

- Has outstanding attention to detail

- Is proactive rather than reactive

- Has excellent written English

- Uses good judgement and can think for themselves

- Notices missing information, mistakes and unfinished tasks

- Communicates warmly and professionally

- Is comfortable working independently

- Can distinguish between something they can handle themselves and something Ryan needs to see

- Takes genuine ownership rather than simply completing assigned tasks



Experience with Slack, Gmail and Fiverr would be useful, but attitude, communication and judgement matter more to me than knowing every piece of software.



Hours & pay:

This will initially be a small, part
 position, rather than a traditional 40-hour working week.

I'm currently budgeting approximately $300-$400 USD per month, depending on experience, availability and the arrangement we agree. Of course, this depends on whether we do a fixed rate or an hourly rate.



The role has the potential to grow as the agency grows.



How to apply:

Please don't send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with the words "Yorkshire Tea", so I know you've read the full job description.



Then answer these four questions:

1. Tell me briefly about your experience handling client communication or customer success.



2. A client
s:

"Hi Ryan, sales have dropped quite badly since last Thursday. Can you take a look? We've also got a promotion starting Monday, so ideally we'd like this sorted before then."

Write the reply you would send to the client.



3. What would you do internally after sending that reply? Be specific.



4. Rewrite this sentence naturally in British English:



"Hi James, I wanted to reach out and see if you had gotten a chance to review the report we sent over. Please let me know if you have any questions."



5. Please record a quick video so I can hear your voice and see you. Only needs to be 1 minute - 2 mins long.



I'm looking for someone I can trust long-term as the agency grows. If you're proactive, meticulous and an excellent communicator, I'd love to hear from you!



Thank you.

title: Digital Designer
description:
# Digital Designer



## Role Overview



We are looking for a creative and commercially minded **Digital Designer** to develop high-quality visual materials across digital, web, print and physical brand touchpoints.



The role covers **graphic design, website design, UI/UX, branding, marketing collateral and corporate materials**. You should be comfortable taking an idea or business requirement and turning it into clean, professional and user-friendly designs.



## Key Responsibilities



### Brand & Corporate Design

- Develop and maintain a consistent visual identity across all company materials.

- Design **name cards, letterheads, envelopes, folders and other corporate stationery**.

- Create brochures, flyers, fact sheets, reports, proposals and corporate profiles.

- Design signage, banners, posters, event backdrops and other physical marketing materials.

- Prepare branded templates for documents, presentations and communications.

- Maintain brand guidelines and ensure consistent use of fonts, colours, logos and layouts.

- Prepare artwork and files for professional printing and production.

- Liaise with printers and external vendors where required and review proofs before production.



### Website & Digital Design

- Design and improve company websites and landing pages.

- Create page layouts, graphics, icons, banners and other digital assets.

- Maintain consistent visual presentation across websites.

- Work with developers or website platforms to translate designs into working pages.

- Ensure websites are responsive and work well across desktop and mobile.

- Continuously improve website usability, navigation and presentation.



### UI/UX & Product Design

- Design interfaces for client portals, dashboards and internal digital tools.

- Develop wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes.

- Improve user journeys and simplify complex processes.

- Design forms, workflows, dashboards and information displays that are intuitive and easy to use.

- Work with technology and automation teams when new digital products or features are being developed.



### Marketing & Content Design

- Create graphics and visual content for LinkedIn and other digital channels.

- Turn written content into engaging visual formats, including carousels, infographics and short-form graphics.

- Design marketing campaigns, advertisements and promotional materials.

- Support launches, announcements, events and thought-leadership content.

- Create event invitations, programmes, presentation materials and branded merchandise artwork.

- Produce simple video, animation or motion graphics where appropriate.



### Presentations & Business Materials

- Design professional PowerPoint and presentation decks.

- Improve the visual quality of proposals, pitches and client materials.

- Develop reusable templates to enable teams to produce consistent materials efficiently.

- Convert complex information into clear charts, diagrams and visual explanations.



### AI-Assisted Design

- Use AI-enabled design tools to improve the speed and quality of design production.

- Experiment with new tools for image generation, layout, content creation and prototyping.

- Develop efficient and repeatable design workflows.

- Maintain appropriate human review and quality control over AI-generated materials.



## Requirements



- Experience in digital, graphic, web or UI/UX design.

- Strong visual design skills and attention to detail.

- Good understanding of typography, layout, colour, branding and visual hierarchy.

- Experience with tools such as **Figma, Canva and Adobe Creative Suite** or equivalent.

- Experience preparing artwork for both **digital use and professional printing**.

- Ability to design responsive websites and digital interfaces.

- Ability to translate business requirements into clear and attractive designs.

- Comfortable working independently and managing multiple projects.

- Good written and spoken English.

- Strong organisational skills and ability to meet deadlines.



Experience with any of the following would be advantageous:

- Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign.

- Webflow, Wix, WordPress or similar website platforms.

- HTML/CSS or basic front-end development.

- Video editing and motion graphics.

- AI image and design tools.

- Designing SaaS platforms, customer portals or dashboards.

- Print production and working with printers or production vendors.

- Professional services, technology, financial services or B2B businesses.



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



- Creative but commercially practical.

- Able to produce clean, modern and professional work.

- Strong in both **digital and print design**.

- Fast and comfortable iterating based on feedback.

- Detail-oriented and particular about presentation.

- Interested in technology and AI.

- Able to think about the **user experience**, rather than simply making something look attractive.

- Proactive in suggesting ways to improve the organisation's overall visual presentation.



## Key Outputs



The Digital Designer will be expected to contribute to:



- Name cards and corporate stationery.

- Letterheads and document templates.

- Brochures, flyers and corporate profiles.

- Signage, banners and event materials.

- Websites and landing pages.

- Client portals and dashboards.

- UI/UX designs and prototypes.

- Social media graphics and carousels.

- Presentations and pitch decks.

- Reports and marketing collateral.

- Brand guidelines and design systems.

- Digital campaigns.

- AI-assisted creative workflows.



## Employment Type



Part Time



## Role Title



**Digital Designer**



Alternative titles include **Digital & Graphic Designer**, **Brand & Digital Designer**, or **Digital & UI/UX Designer**.

title: AI Automation Expert
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and

Tegelstudio (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. We are building an

AI-first operation and want a hands-on automation expert to help run it.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You design, build and maintain the automations behind our content, SEO and lead handling. The core is a

status-driven content pipeline that runs for several brands at once, from keyword research to an approved post

on WordPress. Next to that you build our lead and CRM flows in Bitrix24, including AI reply suggestions in

Dutch that get better from won/lost outcomes. Nothing goes live without human approval, and you build that in

from the start. Your work spans the whole BKG group, with our bathroom brand (Sanitairstudio) as the biggest

single focus.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Build and run our content pipeline in 
 for several brands: keyword research, AI draft, SEO scoring

and revision, human approval, WordPress publishing and repurposing.

Keep it status-driven: a Google Sheets control sheet where each step reliably triggers the next.

Build the AI steps on the Claude API: system prompts that hold our brand voice, return structured JSON and

follow strict content rules. Example: customer reviews are quoted word for word and never invented.

Build lead and approval flows with Bitrix24 webhooks, such as approve/reject buttons that write back to the

automation, plus AI reply suggestions for our Dutch team.

Monitor, troubleshoot and document: error handling, usage costs, and handover material that non-technical

colleagues can use.



REQUIRED SKILLS

Proven hands-on experience building production workflows in 
: scenarios, routers, filters,

repeaters/loops, scheduling, error handling and keeping operations (credits) usage efficient.

Able to design status-driven, multi-stage pipelines where each step triggers the next reliably.

Strong working knowledge of REST APIs: HTTP requests, headers, authentication (API keys, OAuth 2.0,

application passwords), JSON parsing and mapping.

Experience setting up inbound and outbound webhooks, and with asynchronous API patterns: starting a job,

waiting, then fetching and handling results.



Hands-on experience calling the Anthropic Claude API (or a similar LLM API) directly, with strong prompt

engineering: consistent brand voice, reliable structured JSON, strict content rules.

Able to build iterative AI loops, such as draft → score → revise → re-score, with sensible stop conditions and

cost control.

Experience automating WordPress through its REST API (drafts, posts, categories, tags, application

passwords) and comfortable using Google Sheets as a control layer (structured data, data validation,

lookups).

Solid understanding of SEO fundamentals, so the automation improves rankings rather than just producing

more content.

Quality and security: you build in human-in-the-loop checkpoints, handle credentials and API keys securely,

resolve authentication, formatting and rate-limit issues on your own, and write clear documentation.

Fluent spoken and written English. You can explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical team

members.



TOOLS WE USE

Experience with these is a strong plus. We don’t expect you to know all of them; tell us which ones you have

worked with.

SEMrush: keyword research, Keyword Gap, Content Gap, and the API/MCP options on different plans.

NeuronWriter or similar SERP-based content optimization tools (Surfer, Clearscope), including their APIs and

content scoring.

Google Search Console: property verification, performance data (clicks, impressions, average position) and

pulling that data through the API.

Bitrix24: inbound and outbound webhooks and approval flows.

MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting AI tools to external data sources such as SEMrush.

Google reviews through review aggregators (Trustmary, EmbedSocial, Elfsight) and/or the Google Business

Profile API.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience running automations for multiple brands or websites at once.

Experience tracking and optimizing API and usage costs.

Basic scripting (JavaScript or Python) for edge cases that no-code tools can’t handle.

Experience with content repurposing workflows (blog to LinkedIn, Instagram and newsletter).

Experience with n8n.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Full-time, 40 hours per week. You meet regularly with our Dutch colleagues during Amsterdam business hours

(CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. Flexible otherwise. A reliable, high-speed

internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS

You take ownership and work independently: you don’t wait to be told what to do next. If you spot a way to

improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager. You build systems that produce Dutch

output you can’t read yourself, so approval steps and quality safeguards matter to you.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$1,275/month, with room to grow for the right person. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.





HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “SCENARIO” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four

questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Describe one 
 scenario you built that runs in production: what triggers it, the main modules and

routers, how errors are handled, and roughly how many operations (credits) it uses per run or per month.

2. Describe one automation where you called an LLM API (Claude or similar) directly. How did you get valid

JSON back every time, and how do you stop the model from making things up? For example: we quote

customer reviews word for word and never invent them.

3. We want a content pipeline where an article is drafted by AI, scored by an SEO tool, revised and re-scored,

and published to WordPress only after a human approves it. How would you structure this: which stages or

statuses, where the approval sits, and what stops the revise loop from running forever or burning budget?

4. Give one example of an integration that was asynchronous (start a job, wait, fetch the result) or that kept

failing (authentication, rate limits, formatting). What exactly did you do?

Also include:

Links to two automations you have built: one in 
 and one using an AI/LLM API. Screenshots, a

blueprint export or a short screen recording are fine. Only share what already exists; please don’t build

anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are

available for meetings with our Dutch team.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: WordPress Multisite Developer
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW



BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and Tegelstudio (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. Our websites bring in the leads the whole group runs on.



JOB DESCRIPTION



You build and maintain the websites of the BKG group. We are bringing our brand sites together on one WordPress Multisite built with Elementor Pro: 13 brand sites to start, growing to 25+. Your first job is the design system that every brand site is built from. After that you build and launch brand after brand, while the current live sites keep running until each new one is ready. About a fifth of your time goes to the website of our bathroom brand, Sanitairstudio. You think about all sites at once, not one at a time.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS



Build our Elementor design system on the Multisite: design tokens (colors, typography, spacing), about 12 reusable components and 5 page templates, with a mobile Lighthouse score of 85 or higher.

Build brand sites from that system (8 to 10 pages each), so a change is made once and each brand keeps its own logo, colors and name.

Launch each brand on its real domain together with our SEO specialist: redirect mapping, domain mapping, SSL, Cloudflare, sitemap and Search Console checks after launch.

Connect lead forms (Gravity Forms) to our CRM (Bitrix24) and automations through webhooks, and build the tracking basis (data layer, tags) into the templates.

Keep the network healthy: tested updates, backups, security and Core Web Vitals across all sites.

Maintain and improve the Sanitairstudio website: templates, speed, mobile and lead forms (about 8 hours a week).

Document what you build so colleagues can maintain it. Later on: WooCommerce shops.



REQUIRED SKILLS



3+ years of professional WordPress development, including hands-on work on a Multisite network (subdomains, domain mapping) or a comparable multi-brand setup you can show.

Strong in Elementor Pro: Theme Builder, global colors and fonts, reusable templates and components, dynamic tags, custom CSS.

Able to design a system where a change is made once and reaches every site, while each brand keeps its own identity.

Solid PHP, HTML, CSS and [removed] custom functions, hooks, shortcodes or a small plugin when Elementor alone isn’t the right tool.

Performance optimization with measurable Core Web Vitals results (LCP, INP, CLS): caching, images, fonts, scripts and lean Elementor builds.

Site launches and migrations without losing rankings: 301 redirect mapping, domain mapping, SSL, DNS basics and checks after launch.

Forms and integrations: lead forms that reliably deliver to a CRM through webhooks or an API, plus tracking events for analytics (Google Tag Manager, data layer).

A safe way of working on live sites: staging, backups, tested plugin updates, rollback, and careful handling of credentials.

Clear documentation, and fluent spoken and written English.



TOOLS WE USE



This is our stack. Elementor Pro is required; experience with the rest is a plus. Tell us which ones you have worked with.



Hello Elementor theme with Elementor Pro and ElementsKit.

Gravity Forms for lead forms.

Rank Math for SEO, and a redirect manager for migrations.

BerqWP, Redis object cache and Cloudflare for performance.

WordPress REST API and application passwords: our content automation creates drafts through the API.

Bitrix24 (CRM) and 
 on the receiving end of form webhooks.



NICE TO HAVE



WooCommerce: we will add shops later.

Experience with 10 or more sites on one network.

Experience moving a Multisite from shared hosting to managed WordPress hosting.

WP-CLI and Git.

Technical SEO basics: schema markup, canonical and indexing settings.

A good eye for design details and accessibility basics (WCAG).

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY



Full-time, 40 hours per week. You meet regularly with our Dutch colleagues during Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. Flexible otherwise. A reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS



One source, many brands: you build reusable systems instead of one-off pages. You keep performance and consistency front of mind, you test before you touch a live site, and you document what you build. If you spot a way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY



$637/month, with room to grow for the right person. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES



Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word “NETWORK” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:



Describe one Multisite or multi-brand WordPress project you built: how many sites, which page builder, what was shared across the sites and what was set per site.

We build with Elementor Pro on a Multisite. A shared header component changes. How do you get that change onto every brand site while each brand keeps its own logo, colors and name? Tell us what you would build once and what stays per site.

You launch a rebuilt site on its real domain, replacing a live site that ranks in Google and brings in leads. What are your steps before, during and after the switch so rankings and leads survive?

Links to two sites you built, at least one of them on a Multisite or part of a multi-brand setup, with a short note on your part in each. Only share what already exists; please don’t build anything for this.

Which of the tools under “Tools we use” you have worked with, and which hours (Philippine time) you are available for meetings with our Dutch team.

title: DeFi Partnerships Manager: Run the Reps, Book the Calls, Earn Uncapped Overrides
description:
Part-time: 20 hrs/week | $10/hr base + $100 per appointment you book + overrides and deal bonuses, no cap | Remote | Crypto/DeFi



At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month from base and appointment bonuses alone, before any partnership revenue, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗚𝗠𝗜



GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).



LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.



Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.



We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲



One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.



𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗰



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2 personally booked, target 5 team total, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.



𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗼𝘄𝗻



1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ on our Reach/Health/Access rubric passes to the founder. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:



Positive reply → meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.



Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."



"Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.



If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves. All activity is logged in our tracker same day. Unlogged work doesn't exist and doesn't pay.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.



If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show.



Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



𝗧𝗶𝗺𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin

𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟯𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 (𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗱 𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹)



Week 1: full audit of every rep and the current pipeline, clean pipeline and reporting live, personal outreach started.

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Zero held by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review.

Day 30: 2+ qualified appointments held per week pace, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 3+/week.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻



Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week



Minimum Requirement: 2 qualified appointments held per week that you personally booked. Your base pay covers these first two. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked beyond your weekly minimum of 2

$30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep package.



- Commission: 20% of all upgrade fees generated by the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through the partnership during its first 180 days live.

- No ceiling on either.

- Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

- Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn a 20% override on everything the rep earns from that partnership, both their 20% commission on upgrade fees and their 3% launch bonus, for the same 180-day window. Paid by GMI on top of their earnings, never deducted from them.



Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.



Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships.



No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both).



Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard.



Base and appointment bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and $GMI, with the GMI portion on an 18-month vesting schedule. Commission are paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



𝗥𝗲𝗾𝘂𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀



- Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

- Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

- Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

- Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

- Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

- Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call
