title: META ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR
description:
META ADS | AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR



We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.

We're looking for someone who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels.

This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide





Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)




 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases





UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly





Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action





Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof





VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure





Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals. We're looking for someone who understands how ads work.

You should know how to make videos that:

Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds





Make the problem feel real and urgent





Show the product clearly and persuasively





Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention





Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok





Communicate benefits quickly and clearly





Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof





Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase





You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes… then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.

THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands





Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them





Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative





Can create multiple ad variations quickly





Know how to follow references without copying them blindly





Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow





Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused





Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast





Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good





We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation





ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover





Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video





At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use





 you also have experience with:

Meta/Facebook ad creatives





Short-form paid social videos





Long-form VSLs or sales videos





Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing





Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools





Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen





Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts





Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield





Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs





Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references





Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles





Creating variations of winning ads for further testing





Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs





Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios





Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized





Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance





Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations





WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Competitive compensation based on experience





The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue





Clear creative direction and fast feedback





Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively.





We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

, Expedia, or Airbnb is preferred.

title: Project Manager – PH
description:
Job Overview: 

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Project Manager to lead the planning and delivery of product modules within our HR SaaS platform. This role requires strong product management expertise, a data-driven mindset, and the ability to collaborate across design, engineering, and QA teams. The ideal candidate will have experience in B2B SaaS, a solid grasp of HR business processes, and a passion for building user-friendly, AI-driven solutions that address real-world HR challenges.



Responsibilities:



* Own the planning and delivery of one or more product modules.

* Translate customer needs, competitive analysis, and data insights into clear PRDs and executable iteration plans.

* Collaborate with design, engineering, and QA throughout requirement review, development, acceptance, and release.

* Drive product design for compensation-related features (salary structures, merit/adjustment workflows, market pricing).

* Track post-launch usage data and customer feedback to improve product experience.

* Contribute to the product’s AI roadmap (AI Q&A, intelligent reporting, smart insights).



Requirements:

* Solid understanding of multi-tenant SaaS design patterns (permissions, data isolation, approval workflows).

* Strong requirement analysis and documentation skills; able to produce PRDs, prototypes (Axure/Figma), and competitive analyses.

* Data-driven mindset; able to validate product hypotheses and inform iteration decisions.

* Excellent cross-functional communication and prioritization skills.

* Strong English reading and writing skills.



Nice to Have:



* Familiarity with HR business processes and compliance requirements.

* Experience in HCM/HR SaaS modules (Core HR, recruiting, compensation, performance, attendance).

* Experience with compensation data products (salary market data, job pricing/matching, salary structure design, survey data).

* Hands-on experience shipping AI product features (Copilot, AI Q&A, AI-powered reporting).

* Background transitioning into product management from customer success or HR practitioner role.



What We Offer:



* Competitive salary package

* Flexible work-from-home setup.

* Opportunities for career growth and professional development.

* Exposure to innovative HR SaaS and AI-driven product features.

* Collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: CapCut Editor: Replace Voiceovers & Sync Captions on Video Ads (Ongoing Work, Paid Test)
description:
Hi there! I run a few e-commerce brands that are launching in new countries. We have a large library of English video ads that need to be adapted into other languages, and I'm looking for a dependable CapCut editor to handle this.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



For each video, I'll provide the original ad, a translated voiceover file and the script. Your job is to replace the original audio with the new voiceover, generate captions using CapCut's auto-caption feature, line them up with the audio, and adjust the timing wherever it's off. No knowledge of the language is required. Most videos run 1–3 minutes, and I'll share a Loom video that walks you through the whole process step by step.



On some videos, you'll also need to add B-roll clips, either by creating them with AI video tools or by sourcing suitable stock footage.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Someone who knows their way around CapCut (auto-captions, audio editing, speed changes)

A detail-oriented person who catches small timing issues

Someone dependable who picks up a video when it arrives and tells me when it's finished

Big plus: experience generating video clips with AI tools, or finding good stock footage that fits an ad



HOW WE'LL START



We'll begin with a paid test: one real video for $15, with the tutorial included. If it goes well, there's steady ongoing work that will increase as we launch in more markets. Once we have a clearer picture of the volume, we'll work out the rate and setup together.



TO APPLY



Begin your proposal with the word KAFFE so I know you've read the full post. Then tell me:



Links to 2–3 videos you've edited in CapCut, plus a short note on what you did on each

How long you've been using CapCut

Have you created video clips with AI tools or sourced B-roll before? If so, which tools or sites did you use?

Whether you're currently working with other clients, and how many hours a week you could give this project



Brief answers are totally fine. Only applications that follow these steps will be considered.



Thanks, and I look forward to your application! 🙂

title: Senior Short-Form UGC Video Editor
description:
Please read the full post before applying.



ABOUT ME

I'm a UGC creator producing short-form video content. I post 5 videos every day across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Snapchat Spotlight, and
 Reels. I shoot the footage, write the briefs, and handle the brand relationship. I need ONE elite editor to turn my raw footage into polished, high-retention videos, every day, on time, exactly to brief.

This is a long-term, full-time role with guaranteed daily volume, 7 days per week. If you're great, you'll have steady work, a raise path, and bonuses tied to performance.



WHO THIS IS FOR

- You've edited hundreds of short-form vertical videos, and some of them have performed. You know why they performed.

- You treat a brief as a spec, not a suggestion. If the brief says the hook text is white, 6 words, on screen at 0:00, then it is white, 6 words, on screen at 0:00.

- You catch your own mistakes before I do. Typos, audio pops, captions out of sync, text in the platform's UI safe zone. These never reach me.

- You reply fast, you hit deadlines without being reminded, and if something goes wrong, I hear it from you first, before the deadline, with a solution.

- You can work through a full shift without asking questions. You read the brief, check the reference videos, and make smart calls on your own. 

- You want this to be your main client. Small side projects are fine as long as they never affect my deadlines or response times. 



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR

- Editors who need hand-holding or multiple revision rounds to get a brief right

- Template-only editors who apply the same caption preset to everything

- Anyone juggling several other full-time clients



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit 5 short-form vertical videos (15–90 seconds) per day from my raw footage and written briefs

- Build strong hooks: pacing, punch-ins, pattern interrupts, on-screen text in the first 1–2 seconds

- Write and style captions and kinetic text that are 100% accurate and on-brand

- Sound design: music selection and timing, SFX, audio cleanup, consistent levels

- Include any brand-required elements exactly as specified in the brief

- Export to spec and deliver with correct file naming in our shared folder

- Complete revisions if needed and re-deliver the updated videos within 1 hour of receiving my notes. (First versions are due by your daily 6:00 PM deadline.) 



REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- 2+ years editing short-form vertical content, including at least 1 year of paid UGC or ad creative work

- Expert in CapCut desktop

- A portfolio of LIVE posted short-form videos you edited (public links, not just Drive files)

- Experience editing tech, app, SaaS, or AI product content (strongly preferred)

- Strong understanding of platform specs and safe zones for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts

- A computer that handles 4K footage without lag

- Clear written English. Most of our communication is written.

- Responds quickly and submits on time

- Backup power and internet are preferred, but not necessary



RELIABILITY AND COMMUNICATION STANDARDS

DAILY SCHEDULE (all times Philippine Time)

10:00 AM – Footage, audio, and briefs are in the shared folder. Your shift starts.

10:00 AM to 6:00 PM (or until whenever you’re done with all videos for the day) – Edit all of the day's videos. Work independently; I'm offline.

6:00 PM – Hard deadline. All videos delivered, with any questions or judgment calls noted.

9:00 PM – I send revision notes, if any.

9:00 PM to 10:00 PM – Revisions completed and re-delivered.

- During the initial few hours of working hours: reply to messages within 15 minutes

- Daily check-in message at the start and end of your shift: what's done, what's in progress, any blockers

- If you will miss a deadline for ANY reason, tell me as soon as you know, not after

- Tools: 
 for communication, Google Drive for footage and delivery, Google Drive comments for revisions

- You will work independently. I upload footage and briefs, then I'm offline for the night. Don't expect real-time guidance.

- If something in a brief is unclear, make the best call based on the brief, your past experience, and my past videos, then note your decision when you deliver. If it's a genuine toss-up, deliver both versions.

- Batch any questions and send them with your delivery. I'll answer in the morning.

- Only message me during your shift if something will cause a missed deadline (footage corrupted, files missing, etc.)

- To confirm you’ve read this section, include the word safezone in your answer to Q3



PAY

- $3-5 USD/video (est. $
USD/month) 

- Performance bonuses per video: $5 at 50k views, $15 at 100k views, $40 at 250k views, $75 at 500k views, $150 at 1M views, $500 at 5M+ views (views counted 14 days after posting)

- $40 monthly bonus for zero missed deadlines

- $20 monthly bonus for zero revisions caused by editor errors

-Bonuses are uncapped, so one viral video can add a significant amount to your month. 



HOW TO APPLY

 Subject line must be: UGC EDITOR – [Your Full Name] – [Approximate number of short-form videos you've edited]

In your application, include:

1. Three LIVE links to short-form vertical videos you edited. At least one should be a product, app, or tech ad. For each, write one sentence on what YOU specifically did (editing only? captions? sound? hook concept?) and how it performed if you know.

2. A 60–90 second voice note or video (Loom, Google Drive, etc.) introducing yourself and explaining your editing process. No script reading.

3. Short, specific answers to these questions in your own words. Short and sharp beats long and generic. AI-written answers are easy to spot and will be rejected.

 Q1. Walk me through exactly what you do in the first 3 seconds of a UGC ad, and why.

 Q2. My brief asks for something you're confident will perform worse than your idea. What do you do?

 Q3. What's on your personal quality control checklist before you deliver a video?

 Q4. Your power goes out 2 hours before a deadline. Walk me through what happens next.

 Q5. Honestly, how many finished 30–45 second UGC videos at your portfolio's quality can you deliver in an -8-hour shift?

 Q6. Attach a screenshot of a speed test from your main internet (and a picture of your backup power/internet if you have it, but not necessary).

4. Your current client load and how many hours per week you're truly available.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review

2. Paid test edit: shortlisted editors get real raw footage plus a real brief, with a 24-hour window. Paid $5. Graded on brief adherence first, quality second, speed third.

3. 1-week paid trial at full workload

4. Long-term commitment/contract



If you are the kind of editor who takes pride in delivering exactly what was asked, on time, every time, I want to work with you. I look forward to your application.

title: SENIOR DTC PRODUCT RESEARCH, DEVELOPMENT & FULFILLMENT SPECIALIST
description:
Daggo Group LLC is building a portfolio of international Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) brands, beginning with the United States.



We are looking for an experienced DTC operator who has already worked behind the scenes with successful e-commerce brands.



This is NOT an entry-level research position.



We do not want someone we need to train on how DTC works.



We are looking for someone who already understands how to move from:



Market → Customer → Problem → Product Opportunity → Validation → Economics → Supplier → Fulfillment → Launch



WHAT WE NEED



You should be able to receive a market or business objective and independently:



• Research the market and customer.



• Identify high-value customer problems and opportunities.



• Conduct Voice of Customer research.



• Analyze existing products, competitors and customer complaints.



• Identify and evaluate potential product solutions.



• Validate product opportunities before significant capital is committed.



• Understand DTC unit economics, including COGS, AOV, CAC, contribution margin, returns and inventory requirements.



• Research and evaluate manufacturers and suppliers.



• Understand product development, sampling, MOQ, quality control and landed cost.



• Understand US fulfillment and 3PL requirements.



• Identify operational risks before launch.



• Build clear recommendations based on evidence.



• Tell us when an opportunity should be CONTINUED, MODIFIED or KILLED.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked directly with DTC/e-commerce brands in areas such as:



• Product research and development

• E-commerce operations

• Market and customer research

• Product sourcing

• Supplier management

• Inventory planning

• Fulfillment / 3PL

• Product launches

• DTC unit economics



We are NOT primarily looking for:



• General virtual assistants

• Entry-level product researchers

• Dropshipping “winning product” hunters

• Shopify designers

• People whose experience is mainly theoretical



You should already know the tools, research methods and information sources required to do this work.



We care more about the QUALITY and SPEED of your execution than the number of hours you work.



This is a deliverables-driven engagement, not a 40-hour-per-week research job.



COMPENSATION



We are prepared to pay above typical market rates for exceptional candidates.



Target compensation is approximately $2,500 USD/month equivalent, depending on experience, capability and engagement structure.



We are also open to project-based compensation for the initial engagement.



INITIAL ENGAGEMENT



The successful candidate will first be engaged on a paid project/contract.



You will work on a real DTC opportunity from our current pipeline.



We will evaluate:



• Quality of thinking

• Research depth

• Commercial judgment

• Speed of execution

• Independence

• Product-development knowledge

• Supplier and fulfillment knowledge

• Communication and responsiveness

• Ability to identify risks

• Ability to make decisions without constant Founder input



Exceptional performance can lead to an ongoing long-term engagement with Daggo Group LLC.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with:



“DTC OPERATOR”



Then answer the following:



1. Which DTC/e-commerce brands have you worked with? State your exact role and responsibilities.



2. Describe one product you helped take from research/opportunity identification through development or launch.



3. What part of the process did YOU personally own?



4. Describe one product or market opportunity you recommended NOT pursuing and why.



5. Describe your experience working with manufacturers, suppliers, samples, MOQ, landed costs and quality control.



6. Describe your experience with US fulfillment, 3PLs, inventory and returns.



7. Give an example where your research or operational decision directly improved revenue, margin, conversion, inventory efficiency or another measurable business outcome.



8. Which tools do you personally use for market research, competitive intelligence, sourcing and DTC analysis?



9. What is your current availability and how quickly can you complete a typical market/product opportunity assessment?



10. What compensation structure do you prefer: project-based, monthly retainer or another arrangement?



Please include evidence, portfolio examples or references where possible.



AI tools are welcome, but we are hiring your EXPERIENCE, JUDGMENT and EXECUTION — not your ability to generate a research report with AI.

title: TikTok Operator (Shop & Account)
description:
[Read properly before applying]

[Do not apply if you do not meet the requirements or you do not possess the ample experience]

[This is NOT a VIDEO EDITOR job opening]

[This is NOT a CONTENT CREATOR job opening]

---



We're hiring a TikTok Operator to run and grow our U.S. TikTok Shop. This isn't a content or social media job — it's a business role. You'll own the whole channel: TikTok Shop, creators/affiliates, content, ads, livestreams, and the numbers behind all of it.



We want a builder! Someone who either launched a TikTok Shop from zero and made it succeed, or took over a shop that wasn't performing and turned it around. It needs to be *their* win — not a channel they just helped run while someone else called the shots.



You'll start hands-on, with room to build and lead a team as the channel grows.





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon, and willing to travel to NCR whenever the CEO is in Manila to check in with the team

- Was the main driver — not just a helper — behind a TikTok Shop's growth or launch. This means one of:

 [1] Launched a TikTok Shop from scratch and built it into a success (or at least got it to a strong state before leaving the company/client), or...

 [2] Took over a TikTok Shop with little to no traction (low sales/GMV) and turned it around

- Can clearly explain *their own* strategy and decisions behind that growth — not just point to results the shop achieved under someone else's plan

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

title: AI Fashion Video Editor (Face Swap + Garment Swap) – Activewear Brand
description:
About us

Isla Active is an activewear brand based in Koh Samui, Thailand. We're scaling paid social ads on Meta, TikTok and Instagram Reels, and we're looking for a highly experienced AI fashion video specialist to produce photorealistic ad creatives.



The project

We'll give you reference videos from other clothing and activewear brands. For each one, you will:



Swap the face of the content creator with our Thai model's face. The result must be fully photorealistic, with natural skin texture, lighting match, expressions, lip and eye movement, and no flicker or artifacts across frames.

Swap the clothing in the video for our own Isla Active pieces, using our product photos. The colors, fabric texture, seams, logos and fit must be accurate, and the fabric must move naturally with the body (stretch, folds, motion during exercise).

Deliver ad-ready edits in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1, with hooks, captions, text overlays and music where needed.

Produce multiple variations per concept for A/B testing.



The final output must not look AI-generated. This is the most important requirement.



Must-have experience



High-level, proven experience in AI fashion video content creation. We need garment swapping in motion, not just static images.

Advanced AI face-swap skills for video, with consistent identity across shots and multiple videos.

Expert command of current AI video and image tools (video-to-video, inpainting, character consistency, upscaling, frame interpolation). Please list your exact stack.

Strong traditional editing and compositing skills (After Effects, DaVinci, Premiere or similar) to clean up artifacts and color-grade the final output.

Experience producing short-form performance ads for ecommerce or DTC brands.



Nice to have



Activewear, sportswear or athleisure experience

Experience with Asian or Thai models

ComfyUI or custom workflow building

Ability to train custom character or product models (LoRA or similar)



How to apply (applications without these will be skipped)



3–5 links to AI fashion videos you made, including before/after examples of face swaps and garment swaps in motion

Your tool stack and a short description of your workflow

How you keep the face and clothing consistent and artifact-free across frames

Your rate per finished 15–30s ad and per variation, plus typical turnaround

Your time zone and availability



Paid test task

Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test: one 10–15 second reference clip with a face swap to our model and a garment swap to an Isla Active outfit. We'll hire based on realism.



Engagement

Freelance or contract, remote, with ongoing monthly volume for the right person.

title: Property manager
description:
Remote Property Manager – NSW, Australia Portfolio



**Location:** Philippines – Remote / Work From Home

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Working Hours:** 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

**Industry:** Real Estate / Property Management

**Company:** IC Realty



## About the Role



IC Realty is seeking an experienced, responsible and highly organised **Remote Property Manager** based in the Philippines to join our property management team.



This is a long-term, full-time remote position supporting our property management portfolio in **New South Wales, Australia**.



The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of residential property management, excellent communication and organisational skills, and ideally previous experience working with an Australian real estate agency.



You will work closely with our Sydney-based team and assist with the day-to-day management of residential properties while delivering a high standard of service to landlords and tenants.



## Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:



* Managing day-to-day communication with landlords, tenants, tradespeople and other stakeholders

* Responding to tenant and landlord enquiries professionally and promptly

* Coordinating repairs and maintenance, including obtaining quotes and following up with contractors

* Monitoring rental arrears and following up outstanding payments

* Assisting with lease renewals, rent reviews and tenancy documentation

* Preparing notices, letters and property management correspondence

* Coordinating ingoing, outgoing and routine inspection processes

* Maintaining accurate property and tenancy records

* Following up outstanding property management matters and ensuring tasks are completed on time

* Assisting with bond, lease and tenancy-related administration

* Supporting the property management team with portfolio administration and reporting

* Ensuring property management procedures comply with relevant **NSW residential tenancy legislation and regulations**

* Providing excellent customer service to both landlords and tenants

* Proactively identifying issues and following them through to resolution



## Requirements



To be considered for this position, you should have:



* **Minimum 2 years of property management experience**

* Strong knowledge of residential property management processes

* Good understanding of **NSW property management requirements and residential tenancy regulations**

* Previous experience working with an Australian real estate agency is highly preferred

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent organisational and time-management skills

* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities independently

* A responsible, reliable and proactive attitude

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Confidence communicating with landlords, tenants and contractors

* Ability to work independently while being part of a remote team

* Good computer skills and ability to learn property management software quickly



Experience with Australian property management systems such as **PropertyMe, Property Tree, Console Cloud or similar platforms** will be highly regarded.



## Working Hours



This is a **full-time position of 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday**.



Working hours will be aligned with the Australian business day and the requirements of our NSW property management team.



Applicants must be comfortable working according to Australian business hours.



## Benefits



We are looking for someone who wants to build a stable, long-term career with our business.



Benefits include:



* Permanent full-time remote work

* Work from home in the Philippines

* 40-hour working week, Monday to Friday

* **Australian public holidays observed**

* Additional payment for approved overtime work

* Stable, long-term employment opportunity

* Opportunity to work directly with an Australian real estate agency

* Professional development and ongoing training

* Supportive team environment

* Opportunity to grow within our property management department



## The Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is not simply completing administrative tasks, but who genuinely takes ownership of their work.



The ideal candidate is:



* Responsible and dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Proactive rather than reactive

* Comfortable following up outstanding matters

* Able to communicate professionally with clients and tenants

* Capable of prioritising urgent matters

* Calm when dealing with difficult situations

* Willing to learn and improve

* Interested in building a long-term career in Australian property management



## How to Apply



Please submit your **CV/resume** together with a short introduction covering:



1. Your previous property management experience

2. How many years you have worked in property management

3. Whether you have previously worked for an Australian real estate agency

4. Your experience with NSW residential property management

5. Property management software you have used

6. Your current location in the Philippines

7. Your expected monthly salary

8. Your availability to commence



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to attend an online interview and complete a short property management knowledge assessment.



**Join IC Realty and become part of a growing Australian property management team where reliability, professionalism and excellent client service are highly valued.**

Strong knowledge of pet grooming and experience in pet grooming, pet care, or a closely related industry are required.

, and other communication channels.

QUALIFICATIONS

Customers receive timely, knowledgeable assistance, inquiries turn into confirmed appointments, schedules stay organized, and groomers have the information they need to deliver a great experience for pets and their owners.

title: Patient Enquiry and Referral Coordinator (Remote, Philippines)
description:
BRAIN AID CLINICS · POSITION DESCRIPTION

Patient Enquiry and Referral Coordinator

Owner of the Attract phase 



Function: Attract, the first of four phases in the patient journey (Attract, Convert, Deliver, Re-engage)

Reports to: Practice Manager (consultant), for now

Works closely with: Patient Flow Lead (Convert), the clinical team, and marketing suppliers

Location: Remote, Philippines

Engagement: Full-time contractor

Hours: Monday to Friday, 6:00 am to 3:00 pm Philippine time (8:00 am to 5:00 pm Australian Eastern Standard Time). We operate across two Australian time zones, so some enquiries are one hour further ahead from October to April.

Probation: 3 months, reviewed against the KPIs in section 4





1. PURPOSE OF THE ROLE



Brain Aid Clinics provides neuronavigated rTMS and related brain stimulation treatment across two Australian time zones, mainly for people whose depression, anxiety, chronic pain or PTSD has not responded well to other treatment.



This role owns the Attract phase. You make sure every person who enquires is contacted quickly and kindly, and that as many as possible become a referral onto the waiting list. You also build steady relationships with the GPs, specialists and allied health practices who refer to us. Your work ends when a referral is received. At that point the patient passes to the Patient Flow Lead, who books their psychiatrist review.





2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



2.1 Respond to every enquiry

- Call every new enquiry (web form, phone message,
 or AI receptionist) within one business day, oldest first

- Follow the contact schedule in section 6 for anyone you don't reach, and record every attempt

- On every first call, set three expectations clearly: a GP referral is needed to see the psychiatrist; there is a small out-of-pocket cost per session; and the treatment can feel uncomfortable, often described as a tapping or flicking sensation on the scalp

- Send the explainer video and information pack after each first call



2.2 Turn enquiries into referrals

- Send the enquirer a pre-filled referral request to take to their own GP. We never send a referral request directly to a GP on a patient's behalf.

- Follow up until the referral arrives, the person d
 not to go ahead, or the contact schedule ends

- Log each referral received in GoHighLevel and hand it to the Patient Flow Lead at the daily huddle, with the patient's details complete

- Pass any clinical question (for example "am I suitable?" or "will this work for me?") to the clinical callback list. Never answer these yourself



2.3 Build referrer relationships

- Keep a list of GP practices, psychiatrists, psychologists, allied health providers and scheme case managers (DVA, WorkCover, TAC) in our areas, and contact each on a regular schedule

- Send approved clinical information, and book education sessions and practice visits for our clinicians

- Record every contact and its outcome. Note which referrers send patients, and how often

- Never offer payments, gifts or incentives for referrals



2.4 Keep the data accurate

- Log every call, message and outcome in GoHighLevel on the same day

- Keep each contact in the right pipeline stage, with source and referrer recorded, so the weekly numbers are accurate



2.5 Report and improve

- Submit your weekly numbers by Monday 3:00 pm Philippine time for the Tuesday KPI review

- Bring one suggestion each week for improving response speed or conversion, such as a script change, a follow-up message or a referrer to approach



2.6 Create and manage marketing content

- Create marketing content across all our channels: social media 
, Instagram and LinkedIn), website,
 newsletters, referrer information packs, brochures, flyers and online ads

- Edit and produce your own content, including graphics, photos and short-form videos (Reels, Stories, and clinic or educational clips) with captions, music and BAC branding

- Work with external contractors such as marketing agencies, videographers, photographers and designers: brief them clearly, manage timelines, and review their work before it is used

- Edit and adapt contractor content so it is ready for each channel, for example cutting a longer video into short clips or resizing graphics for different platforms

- Follow BAC brand guidelines for colours, fonts and logo use in everything you create or commission

- Plan a monthly content calendar across all channels, and publish on an agreed schedule

- Keep an organised library of approved content, templates and brand assets

- Send all content for approval before it is published or printed

- Check social media comments and direct messages every day. Treat every enquiry as a new lead: log it in GoHighLevel and follow the contact schedule in section 6

- Reply only with approved responses. Never give medical advice or discuss someone's health publicly. Move any personal or clinical conversation to a private message or a phone call

- Never use patient stories, testimonials, before-and-after content or claims about treatment outcomes in any marketing material

- Only use photos or video of patients or staff who have given written consent

- If anyone mentions self-harm, su
 or feeling unsafe in a comment or message, follow the safety procedure in section 5 straight away

- Include marketing enquiries and results in your weekly numbers



3. WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO



- Give medical advice, or say whether someone is suitable for treatment. The clinical team does this

- Book psychiatrist reviews, MRIs or treatment dates. The Patient Flow Lead (Convert) does this

- Handle billing, payments or scheme claims. Finance and billing does this

- Create brochures or advertising content. Approved materials are supplied to you





4. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS



Referrals received (headline)

Referrals received per week, by source (GP, specialist, allied health, scheme, self-referred)

Target: Set with the Practice Manager after month 1 · Reviewed weekly



Speed to first call

% of new enquiries called within one business day of arriving

Target: 100% (never below 95%) · Reviewed weekly



Contact within 7 days

% of enquiries with a two-way conversation within 7 days

Target: 90% or more · Reviewed weekly



Lead-to-referral conversion

% of enquiries that become a referral received, by source

Target: Baseline in month 1, then improve · Reviewed monthly



Data quality

% of calls and outcomes logged in GoHighLevel the same day

Target: 100% · Spot-checked weekly



Targets are a starting point and will be reviewed with you as we learn what is realistic.





5. SAFETY AND ESCALATION



Some people who contact us are very unwell. If anyone mentions self-harm, su
, or feeling unsafe:

1. Stay on the line, stay calm, and listen.

2. Give them the crisis contacts: 000 in an emergency, and Lifeline on 13 11 14.

3. Call the on-duty clinician straight away on [name and number]. Do not wait until the end of the call or the end of the day.

4. Flag the contact in GoHighLevel. Never add the person to a marketing or follow-up sequence.



You will be trained in this procedure before you take your first call.





6. CONTACT SCHEDULE FOR NEW ENQUIRIES



Day 0: Call. If there's no answer, send an SMS and an
 introducing yourself and the next step

Day 1: Second call at a different time of day

Day 3: Third call and a short SMS

Day 7: Final call and
 letting them know they can reply at any time

After day 7: Move to the monthly information sequence, unless they have asked us to stop or have been flagged





7. A TYPICAL WEEK



Times are Philippine time. Each day starts with new enquiries, oldest first.



Daily

6:00 to 7:30: Call all new enquiries, then work the day's follow-ups from the contact schedule

8:00: 15-minute huddle with the Patient Flow Lead: referrals received, handovers, anything stuck

8:15 to 12:00: Follow-up calls, referral requests sent, GoHighLevel updated as you go

12:00 to 13:00: Break

13:00 to 15:00: Afternoon calls (often the best time to reach people after work in Australia), then referrer outreach



Main focus besides enquiries

Monday: Weekend enquiries (the busiest day). Weekly numbers submitted by 3:00 pm

Tuesday: KPI review with the Practice Manager. Two-hour referrer outreach block

Wednesday: Referrer outreach: information packs and booking clinician education sessions

Thursday: Second follow-up pass on anyone not yet reached. Update the referrer list

Friday: GoHighLevel clean-up, one improvement suggestion, plan for next week





8. SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



Essential

- Excellent spoken and written English, and comfortable with Australian accents

- At least 2 years in a phone-based role, such as patient coordination, healthcare admin, customer success or inside sales

- Calm and kind with people who are unwell or distressed, and willing to hand over when a question is clinical

- Organised and accurate, and follows tasks through to the end

- Confident with a CRM, Google Workspace and a VoIP phone

- Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power, a quiet private workspace, a good headset, and your own computer



Desirable

- GoHighLevel experience

- Healthcare or medical admin experience with Australian or US patients

- Experience building relationships with medical practices or other businesses





9. PRIVACY AND CONFIDENTIALITY



- You will handle health information, which is protected under Australia's Privacy Act 1988. You will sign a confidentiality agreement and complete privacy training before starting

- Work only in company systems. Do not save, download, photograph or forward patient information to personal devices or accounts

- Use only approved scripts and materials. Under Australian health advertising rules we do not use patient testimonials or make claims about outcomes

title: LONG-FORM VIDEO EDITOR – Video Podcast (Archival Photos + Broadcast Delivery)
description:
We're producing an 8-episode video podcast. Each episode must pass a technical and standards review needs for Canadian broadcast and airs on a Canadian TV platform and YouTube. 





WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build each 30–35 minute episode from a 2 camera shoot

- Integrate archival photos, documents and newspaper clippings with motion and intercutting

- Clean, balance and mix dialogue to broadcast loudness

- Basic colour correction and broadcast-legal video levels

- Build and maintain the series template: opening card, lower thirds, closing credit card, all title-safe

- Export and name files to spec, then run a QC pass before handoff

- Keep an archival-use log per episode: asset ID, timecode in/out, on-screen duration, and total time of anything marked "outside region"

- Export 3 still-frame options per episode for artwork (1600x900, no text)

- Make revisions from the host, then from the broadcaster's review notes

REQUIREMENTS

- 1+ years editing long-form (20+ min) multicam interview, podcast or documentary content

- DaVinci Resolve (preferred) or Premiere Pro (or equivalent programs)

- Real audio skills: you measure integrated loudness and true peak

- Taste with archival material: photo moves, documents, clippings, object inserts

- Clear written English for timecoded notes and logs

- Internet that can download 50–100 GB per episode, and a machine that handles multicam

- First cut within 5 days of receiving footage



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the words "THE TABLE". Then answer:

1. Link one long-form (20+ min) multicam conversation or documentary you edited. What exactly did you do on it?

2. What loudness target and true peak limit do you mix dialogue to for TV, and what tool do you measure it with?

3. Describe three ways you'd make an old still photograph feel alive on screen without it feeling like a slideshow.

4. Your weekly availability, preferred rate and your turnaround for a first cut of a 35-minute episode.

title: AI Video Editor / AI Filmmaker for DTC E-commerce Brand
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce company looking for a **full-time Video Editor with strong AI video generation skills**.



AI content creation is the priority. You should be able to create high-quality AI footage across different styles, then turn that footage into polished, fast-paced ads.



What You'll Create



We produce AI video in styles including:



- **Ultra-realistic:** footage that is extremely difficult to distinguish from real video

- **Claymation**

- **Pixar-style / high-end 3D animation**

- **3D medical, anatomical, X-ray and skeleton visuals**

- **AI-generated B-roll**

- Other creative AI visual styles as concepts require



We have one important rule:



AI should either look extremely realistic OR deliberately stylized and clearly artificial.



We do **not** want the uncanny middle ground where footage is supposed to look real but obviously looks AI-generated.



What We Need From You



You should be able to:



- Generate high-quality AI video and images

- Work with the latest AI models and quickly learn new ones

- Follow detailed creative briefs accurately

- Turn around work quickly and reliably

- Create multiple variations from your own work

- Iterate quickly when we find a concept, visual or ad that performs

- Work independently and suggest better creative solutions when appropriate

- Edit complete advertisements when needed



Our target production volume is approximately **5–7 videos per week**, including variations of existing videos.



Editing Skills



AI generation is the priority, but you should also be comfortable with:



- Cutting and assembling ads

- Strong pacing

- Animated captions

- Basic motion graphics

- Minor VFX

- Sound effects and sound design

- Music

- Transitions

- Colour correction/grading

- Stabilisation and footage cleanup



Premiere Pro and After Effects experience is preferred, especially because we need complete editable working files.



AI Tools



You should be comfortable working across the current generation of leading AI tools rather than depending on only one platform.



Our current workflow includes tools such as:



- Higgsfield

- Seedance

- Nano Banana

- ChatGPT

- Claude

- ElevenLabs



Experience with other leading video/image generation models such as Kling, Veo, Runway, Sora, ComfyUI or similar tools is a plus.



We can provide required subscriptions when necessary, but **we prefer someone who already has an established AI production workflow and their own tools/subscriptions.**



The same applies to stock footage, music and asset subscriptions.



File Delivery



We care strongly about organised, reusable source material.



For completed work, you may be required to provide:



- Final export **with music and captions**

- Final export **without music and captions**

- Clean AI-generated footage

- Clean source footage/selects, trimmed, stabilised, colour-graded and ready for reuse

- Premiere/After Effects or other project files

- All project assets

- Prompts and generation settings

- Source/reference images

- Music and SFX files

- Editable captions



Your work should be organised so another editor can easily open the project and continue working from it.



Who We're Looking For



You do not need to have 10 years of experience.



We care more about someone who is:



- Hard-working

- Fast

- Reliable

- Available full-time

- Detail-oriented

- Good at following instructions

- Able to learn new AI tools very quickly

- Comfortable receiving feedback

- Able to create variations quickly

- Interested in continuously improving their AI generation skills



Strong previous experience is preferred, but a highly capable intermediate editor who learns extremely quickly is also welcome.



There is **no requirement to work Netherlands/European hours**. You can work according to your normal schedule as long as communication and delivery are reliable.



Application



Start your application with the word: SWEET!



Then answer these questions:



1. How long have you been working with AI video generation?

2. Which AI video and image-generation tools do you currently use?

3. Which AI/software subscriptions do you personally already have?

4. Which editing software do you use?

5. Which stock footage, music or asset subscriptions do you have?

6. Can you provide complete editable project files and source assets?

7. How many videos could you realistically produce per working day?

8. Send your **best examples of photorealistic AI video**.

9. Send your **best examples of stylized/animated AI video**.

10. Send examples of **medical/anatomical/3D AI visuals**, if available.

11. Send examples of your normal video editing work.

12. Tell us briefly about one AI video you created: which tools did you use and what parts did you personally create?



Please send **specific examples of your own work**, not a large generic portfolio.



Shortlisted applicants will first complete a **small test**, followed by a paid full assignment if successful.



This is a full-time position with the potential for long-term work.

title: Website Redesign + SEO Specialist
description:
I’m looking for an experienced web designer/developer with strong SEO knowledge to completely redesign A List Therapy Group’s existing website.

Current site: 



I already have a homepage design concept/style that I like and will attach it to the posting. I need someone who can take that visual direction and build a complete, modern, premium website around it.

This is not just a graphic redesign. I also need the developer to properly handle the website structure, SEO migration, technical SEO, landing pages, performance, and search/AI visibility.



What I Need

The new site will include pages such as:

- Home

- About

- Coverage

- For Agencies

- Join Our Network / Clinicians

- Careers

- Contact

- Privacy/legal pages

- TherapySync external login

The current site is on Wix, but I’m open to Wix Studio, Vercel/Next.js, Webflow, or another platform if you believe it is a better choice.



I care most about:

- Premium modern design

- Fast loading

- Excellent mobile experience

- Strong SEO

- Easy future editing

- Reliable hosting

- Clean navigation and user experience

The existing website must remain live until the replacement is finished and ready to launch.



SEO & Website Migration

SEO is very important to this project.

I need someone who understands how to redesign an existing website without unnecessarily losing existing search rankings or indexed pages.

This should include:

- Review of current pages/URLs

- 301 redirect strategy where needed

- SEO-friendly URL structure

- Page titles and meta descriptions

- H1/H2 structure

- Internal linking

- Canonical URLs

- XML sitemap

- robots.txt

- Schema / structured data

- Image optimization and alt text

- Mobile performance / Core Web Vitals

- Google Search Console

- Bing Webmaster Tools

- Crawl/indexing checks before and after launch



SEO Landing Pages

I also want the site built with a strong landing-page structure for searches related to:

- Home health therapy coverage

- Physical Therapy / PT

- Occupational Therapy / OT

- Speech Therapy / SLP

- PTA / COTA

- Therapy staffing / referral coordination

- California

- Nevada

- Counties and local service areas



I do not want hundreds of low-quality duplicate pages.

I want a scalable structure where we can create useful, well-optimized service and location pages over time.



Google + AI Search

I also want the site structured properly for newer AI-powered search systems in addition to traditional Google/Bing SEO.

This includes things such as:

- Clear company/entity information

- Semantic page structure

- Structured data

- Proper service and geographic information

- Useful FAQs where appropriate

- Strong internal linking

- Crawlable content

- Fast performance

I understand nobody can guarantee #1 rankings or guarantee that an AI will recommend the company. I am looking for legitimate technical and content optimization, not promises.



Existing Functionality

The current website also includes:

- A Careers page connected to our recruiting/job system, which needs to remain functional

- A TherapySync Login button that links to an external platform

These features must be preserved or recreated.

Design / Branding



I will provide:

- Our official logo

- Current website

- Approved homepage design direction

- Existing content

- Company wording/content as needed



The finished website should feel premium, clean, modern, professional, and established — not like a generic healthcare template.

Our actual logo and supplied brand assets must be used correctly. Do not allow AI tools to redesign or approximate the company logo.

There are also specific wording requirements around how independent clinicians are described. I will provide approved wording, and it should be followed rather than rewritten without approval.

Tools / Platform

I am comfortable with modern development and AI tools such as v0, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.

Use whatever tools help you work efficiently.

However, you must also be able to manually correct the website when AI-generated designs or code are inaccurate.

Budget



Fixed-price project: approximately $500.

I am open to reasonable proposals depending on experience and the final agreed scope.

If this project goes well, I also have another company website that will likely need a similar redesign afterward.

When Applying



Please send:

1. 3 websites you personally designed/developed that best show the quality of your work.

2. Which platform you recommend for this project and why.

3. Your experience with SEO-sensitive website migrations.

4. Your experience creating SEO service/location landing pages.

5. Whether you personally do the work or outsource it.

6. Your estimated fixed price and timeline.



Please begin your proposal with:

A LIST WEBSITE

so I know you actually read the posting.

title: Google Search Ads Manager | Claude Code Workflow | Full-Time
description:
ABOUT US



We are a digital services agency helping small and medium businesses grow and protect their online presence. Paid search is a core part of how we deliver results for clients, and we are adding a full-time Google Ads specialist to the team. Remote and long-term.



HOW THE WORK GETS DONE



Most of the day-to-day campaign work here runs through Claude Code, an AI tool that works in a command line (terminal). We use it to build campaigns, run audits, make changes, and produce reports. You do not have to be a developer. You do have to be comfortable typing into a terminal, following a written playbook step by step, reading what the tool returns, and checking it against the live Google Ads account before anything goes live. We provide the playbooks. You bring the Google Ads judgment.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



- Own Google Search campaigns from setup through ongoing optimization

- Run daily and weekly account work through Claude Code using our playbooks

- Handle keywords, negative lists, bids, budgets, and ad copy

- Dig into performance data, find wasted spend, and fix it

- Grow budgets step by step once results justify it

- Log every change you make and the reason behind it



WHAT YOU BRING



- Hands-on Google Ads experience on real accounts. Courses and certificates alone are not enough.

- A track record of growing campaigns from a modest budget to a much larger monthly spend without results falling apart

- Solid Search fundamentals: match types, negative keywords, Quality Score, conversion tracking, and bidding strategies, and knowing when each one fits

- Comfort with tools, dashboards, and precise technical instructions. Working through Claude Code is required, not optional.

- Strong written English and clear, simple reporting

- Reliability, attention to detail, and honesty about what the data shows



THE DETAILS



- PHP 40,000 per month

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, long-term

- Work from home



TO APPLY (WE SCREEN ON THESE STEPS)



We only read applications that complete every step below. Precision matters in this job, so we test for it from the start.



1. Put this word alone on the first line of your message: SEARCH-SCALE



2. Answer these three questions, in this order:

   a) Which companies or accounts have you managed Google Ads for? For each one, give the approximate monthly ad spend and the results you achieved.

   b) Pick ONE campaign you grew. What was the starting budget, what budget did you take it to, and how did cost per lead or cost per sale change along the way? Use real numbers.

   c) Have you worked in a command-line tool or an AI tool such as Claude Code or ChatGPT with tools? Be honest about your experience. If you have not, explain why you would pick it up quickly.



3. Include proof: a screenshot from a Google Ads account you have managed, or a short Loom video walking through one of your accounts. Blur client names if needed.



4. Tell us your full-time working hours and your earliest start date.



Strong applications hear back fast. Generic or copy-paste applications will not get a reply.

title: Virtual Assistant – Electrical Industry & Scheduling Experience

What We Are Looking For

Strongly Preferred

• Previous experience working with an electrical contractor, trades business or field service company

title: Retention Accountability Operator
description:
Pay: $2,000 AUD per month

Type: Full-Time Contractor

Location: Remote

Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Philippine Time



Retention Accountability Operator



About The Company

We are a digital marketing agency that runs paid advertising for small business owners across Australia and New Zealand. We currently manage over $500,000 per week in ad spend across hundreds of client accounts. Our core service is building and managing lead generation campaigns on Meta 
 and Instagram), along with building custom landing page funnels, CRM automations, and sales training systems for our clients.



We are on a mission to hit $1,000,000 per month in revenue. Churn is our biggest enemy. Every client we lose costs us roughly $5,200 per year in recurring revenue, and right now we are losing 27 clients per week. Reducing churn is the single highest-leverage initiative in the business. It adds over $1.3 million annually to the bottom line for every 2% we cut. This role exists to make that happen.



We are fast-paced. Things get done by the end of the day, not the end of the week. If a red flag is spotted at 9am, it is escalated and being acted on by 10am. We track results, not hours worked. We do not care when or how long you work. We care that the retention dashboard is accurate, red flags are caught and escalated, tasks are verified, and churn is dropping.



The Role

You are the Retention Accountability Operator. You work directly with our Integrator and your single KPI is the weekly churn rate. Your job is to own the retention dashboard, ensure every retention system is being executed across all departments, catch problems before they become cancellations, and drive accountability across the team..



You are not a manager. You do not manage people or make strategic decisions. Department leads run their teams. Your job is to check, track, report, escalate, and chase until things are resolved. You find problems and you make sure the right person fixes them. You close the loop on every single flag.



Daily Responsibilities

Data Tracking and Dashboard Ownership

Maintain and update the retention dashboard daily with all churn, refund, and red flag data

Track weekly churn rate against the target of 3.6% (down from current 5.6%)

Log every cancellation with full detail: client name, tenure, cancellation reason, red flags that preceded it, department responsible, and whether intervention was attempted

Track refund requests separately with the same level of detail

Monitor leading indicators daily: red flags raised, save conversations attempted, show rates on onboarding calls, client engagement at 14-day checkpoints, task completion rates across departments



Daily Checklist Execution

Work off a structured daily checklist that covers every retention touchpoint across all three departments (Sales, Onboarding, Ad Running)

Verify that all daily forms and checklists from department staff have been filled out

Confirm that tasks assigned to team members have been completed on time

Flag any incomplete or overdue tasks and escalate to the responsible staff member and their head manager

Ensure the daily huddle agenda is followed and red flags from the previous day are reviewed

Call Reviews Using AI

Run call recordings through ChatGPT prompts to analyze sales calls, onboarding calls, and coaching sessions

Identify over-promising, script deviations, tone issues, missed qualification steps, and compliance concerns

Generate structured reports from AI outputs and distribute to the relevant department lead

Track patterns across calls to identify systemic issues versus one-off i

Follow up with department leads to confirm flagged issues were addressed with the staff member

Message and Communication Review

Review client-facing messages sent by VAs and ads managers across 
, SMS, and

Check that Monday KPI messages were sent correctly and on time

Verify that client responses to the feedback menu options were handled properly

Ensure escalation protocols were followed when clients selected negative feedback options

Flag any communication that could damage client trust or signal an at-risk account



Accountability and Escalation

When issues are found, speak directly with the staff member responsible first

If the issue is not resolved or is repeated, escalate to their head manager

If the issue is systemic or high-risk, escalate directly to the Integrator

Track every escalation from flag to resolution and report unresolved items weekly

Hold department leads accountable for acting on flags within 24 hours of being raised

Communicate clearly and directly with the team about what is being done and what is not being done



Meeting Coverage

Cover daily huddles and weekly retention review meetings from the script when the Integrator is away

Ensure meetings stay on agenda and red flags are captured

Produce meeting notes and action items within 1 hour of the meeting ending

Follow up on action items to confirm completion by deadline



Weekly Reporting

Produce a weekly retention report every Friday covering: churn rate, refund count, red flags raised, red flags resolved, leading indicator trends, department compliance rates, and unresolved escalations

Present the report to the Integrator and business owner

Flag any trends that require strategic intervention versus tactical fixes



What We Expect

You work incredibly hard and fast. Speed matters. A red flag spotted today must be escalated today, not tomorrow.

You are obsessive about detail. A missed form or an unlogged cancellation is a failure of the system you own.

You are direct with people. When a staff member drops the ball, you tell them. You do not soften it or avoid the conversation. But you are not rude. You are clear.

You close loops. A flag is not done when it is reported. It is done when it is resolved and verified.

You do not make excuses. If the churn rate is not improving, you dig into why and surface it. You do not hide behind "the team is not cooperating." You escalate and you document.

You are comfortable using AI tools daily. ChatGPT is your analysis engine. You run the prompts, you read the outputs, you add context, and you distribute the insights.

You track results, not hours. Nobody is watching your clock. Everyone is watching your dashboard.



Skills and Requirements

Must Have

University degree or equivalent demonstrated analytical capability

Excellent written and spoken English. You will be communicating with department leads, staff members, and producing reports the business owner reads. Your communication must be clear, concise, and professional.

Strong critical thinking and pattern recognition. AI does the analysis, but you must be able to read an AI output and know whether it is relevant, whether it needs context added, and who it needs to go to.

High comfort level with AI tools, specifically ChatGPT. You will be running prompts daily and interpreting outputs.

Experience with dashboards, spreadsheets, and data tracking tools (Google Sheets, Asana, GHL)

Ability to hold people accountable without creating conflict. Direct but not aggressive. Firm but respectful.

Extremely organized. You are managing checklists, forms, logs, dashboards, and escalations across three departments simultaneously.

Fast execution. You do not let things sit. If something is flagged, it moves within the hour.



Nice to Have

Experience in a digital marketing or advertising agency environment

Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM

Experience with call review or quality assurance processes

Background in operations or account management



Personal Traits

Relentless work ethic. This is not a clock-in clock-out role. The dashboard does not take days off.

Thick skin. You will be telling people they missed things. Some will push back. You hold the line.

Ownership mentality. The churn rate is your number. You treat it like it is your money on the line, because it is.

Bias toward action. When in doubt, flag it and escalate. Better to over-report than miss something that costs a client.



Compensation

$2,000 AUD per month

Performance bonus tied to churn rate reduction against quarterly targets

Full-time role

Remote

Reporting Structure



Reports directly to the Integrator (Cleo)

Works across all three department leads: Head of Sales, Onboarding Team Lead, Ad Running Team Lead

Escalates systemic issues to the Integrator and business owner

Does not manage any staff. Accountability and reporting only.



Success Looks Like

Churn rate trending from 5.6% toward 3.6% within 90 days

Every cancellation logged with full detail within 24 hours

Red flags caught and escalated before cancellation in the majority of cases

Department compliance on daily checklists and forms above 95%

Weekly report produced every Friday without exception

Zero unresolved escalations older than 72 hours

The business owner never has to ask "did anyone catch this" because the answer is always yes

title: QA Engineer, Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Clients rely on our products every day, so we are hiring a QA engineer whose full focus is making sure they work before anything reaches a user.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You test our most critical applications: our own products and the client applications we run under SLA. You work with the developers and project leads on every release, and you set up the testing process that the rest of the team follows.



- Test before release: run regression and release tests on web applications before they go live

- Automate: build and maintain end-to-end tests (Playwright or similar) and API tests, and run them in CI

- Test AI features: check LLM-powered features for wrong, incomplete or inconsistent output

- Report clearly: write bug reports with steps to reproduce, screenshots and expected behavior, so a developer can fix them without asking

- Set the standard: write test plans and release checklists, and make testing part of how every project ships



What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 2+ years of QA experience on web applications

- Both manual and automated testing, with a tool like Playwright, Cypress or Selenium

- API testing (Postman or similar)

- Excellent English communication, written and verbal

- Precise and persistent: you don't sign off on something you haven't checked yourself



Nice-to-have:

- Writing tests in TypeScript or Python

- Running tests in CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing AI or LLM-powered features

- Testing across browsers and screen sizes, including mobile

- Experience using AI tools like Claude or Claude Code in your work



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar tools to write test cases, generate test data or debug failing tests, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up how MSTR tests its products, and you own quality across projects

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow the QA function

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Freedom to propose: if something should be done differently, we want to hear it

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



Our tech stack



- Cloud: Azure (primary), AI Foundry

- Infrastructure: Pulumi, Docker, GitHub Actions

- Back-end: Python, FastAPI

- Front-end: React, TypeScript

- Database: PostgreSQL

- AI: Claude, Azure OpenAI



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into QA and testing.

2. A complex feature you tested: Walk us through the most complex feature or flow you had to test. What bug did you find that a quick or generic test would have missed?

3. A test setup you built: Walk us through a test suite or testing process you set up. What did you automate, and what did you keep manual?

4. AI in your work: How do you use AI tools in your testing work today? How would you test a feature where the AI gives a different answer every time?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application



Send the following to 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile, or an example of a test plan or bug report you wrote (anonymized)



 subject: "QA Engineer Application - [Your Name]"



What happens next



1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates move to a technical evaluation with our Head of Technology

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



Who should apply



Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Like finding what breaks before a user does

- Speak up early when something is at risk

- Are curious about AI and how to test it



Don't apply if you:

- Only want short-term gigs or are juggling multiple clients

- Aren't willing to create a video response

- Haven't tested web applications that real users depend on



Ready to apply? Send your video and CV to 
 are happy to answer any questions.



We look forward to learning more about you.



MSTR,

Motion design, illustration, or brand identity work in your background

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: Youtube video gaming editor
description:
**JOB TITLE**

World of Warcraft Video Editor & Gameplay Recorder — Monthly Salary + Bonuses + Sponsorship Revenue Share



**Type of work:** [Part-time]

**Location:** Remote



**ABOUT THE ROLE**



We’re looking for a skilled video editor with World of Warcraft knowledge to take ownership of our ongoing **WoW Forever YouTube series**.



This role combines editing, playing the game, following updates and recording original gameplay. You should enjoy WoW, be committed to learning and care about creating accurate, engaging videos for its audience.



You’ll work with our content team to turn video briefs into finished videos, capturing the gameplay needed to explain each topic clearly.



**WHAT YOU’LL DO**



• Edit YouTube videos with strong openings, clear storytelling, engaging pacing and clean audio.

• Play WoW to understand the mechanics, features and changes covered in our videos.

• Record original gameplay that accurately demonstrates the narration.

• Follow relevant announcements, patch notes and community developments.

• Review briefs and scripts, flagging factual errors or unclear information before editing.

• Check that footage, terminology and on-screen information match the game version being discussed.

• Keep footage and project files organized.

• Meet agreed deadlines and communicate progress, questions or blockers early.

• Potentially contribute to other MMORPG series, such as AION, as the channel develops.



Playing, researching and recording are part of the role and will be considered alongside editing when agreeing on workload and compensation.



**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**



• Existing WoW knowledge and a commitment to keep learning.

• A portfolio demonstrating strong gaming or YouTube video editing.

• Confidence using Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or comparable editing software.

• Experience recording gameplay with OBS or similar software.

• A PC capable of running WoW while recording good-quality footage.

• Reliable internet for communication and transferring video files.

• Good English comprehension and clear communication.

• Attention to detail, reliability and the ability to take responsibility for an ongoing series.



**AI SKILLS & TOOLS**



Experience using **ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and ElevenLabs** is required.



**We provide all software and AI-tool subscriptions needed for the work, plus game access and the WoW subscription.**



**ACCURACY IS A CORE REQUIREMENT**



Our audience understands the game, and inaccurate information can damage the channel’s credibility.



You’ll be expected to verify factual claims using the game, official information and reliable sources. AI tools may support your workflow, but AI-generated claims must be checked before they appear in a video.



If something is uncertain, raise it with the team rather than guessing. We value someone who catches problems early, takes feedback seriously and applies corrections consistently.



**WHAT WE OFFER**



Your compensation will include three components:



• **Monthly salary:** A fixed monthly salary clearly stated in your contract.



• **Monthly performance bonus:** Additional earnings based on agreed performance targets.



• **Sponsorship revenue share:** A percentage of sponsorship income from the series you handle, with the percentage and payment terms agreed upfront.



We’ll also cover the game access and subscription costs required for your work.
